Beyond Binary Success: A Diagnostic Meta-Evaluation Framework for Fine-Grained Manipulation VLA

fine-grained manipulation diagnostic meta-evaluation VLA models visual encoder physical dexterity

简要说明：本文提出MetaFine，一个诊断性元评估框架，用于解耦和评估VLA模型中的精细操作能力，揭示架构瓶颈并支持针对性改进。

TLDR: The paper introduces MetaFine, a diagnostic meta-evaluation framework that disentangles and evaluates fine-grained manipulation capabilities in VLA models, revealing architectural bottlenecks and enabling targeted improvements.

Abstract: Fine-grained manipulation marks a regime where global scene context no longer suffices, and success hinges on the tight coupling of local attribute grounding, high-fidelity spatial perception, and constraint-respecting motor execution. However, current embodied AI benchmarks collapse these capacities into binary success rates, systematically inflating reported capabilities by up to 70% and masking the architectural bottlenecks that impede real-world deployment. We introduce MetaFine, a diagnostic meta-evaluation framework that disentangles manipulation competency along three axes: understanding, perception, and controlled behavior. Built on a compositional task graph, MetaFine absorbs heterogeneous external benchmarks and reconstructs them into diagnostic scenarios of varying complexity under a unified protocol. Evaluating state-of-the-art vision-language-action (VLA) models through this lens exposes severe dimension-specific failures invisible to conventional metrics. Through targeted causal intervention, we identify the visual encoder's ability to preserve local spatial structure as a key bottleneck for fine-grained precision: improving it directly unlocks previously inaccessible manipulation capabilities without modifying downstream policies. MetaFine further supports hybrid real-sim validation, using limited paired real-world rollouts to calibrate scalable simulation-based estimates for more stable physical benchmarking. By shifting evaluation from ranking to diagnosis, MetaFine turns benchmarking into an actionable compass for repairing the layered capacities underlying genuine physical dexterity. The MetaFine framework, benchmarks, and supporting resources will be publicly released at our project page: https://metafine.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：精细化操作标志着全局场景信息已不再足够的阶段，成功的关键在于局部属性定位、高保真空间感知与约束遵循运动执行的紧密结合。然而，当前具身人工智能基准测试将这些能力简化为二元成功率指标，系统性夸大报告能力高达70%，并掩盖了阻碍实际部署的架构瓶颈。我们提出MetaFine——一个诊断性元评估框架，将操作能力沿三个维度解构：理解、感知与受控行为。基于组合式任务图谱构建的MetaFine能够吸纳异构的外部基准测试，在统一协议下将其重构为不同复杂度的诊断场景。通过这一视角评估最先进的视觉-语言-行动模型，暴露出传统指标无法观测的维度特异性严重缺陷。通过针对性因果干预，我们发现视觉编码器保持局部空间结构的能力是制约精细化精度的关键瓶颈：改进该能力可直接解锁先前无法实现的操作技能，而无需修改下游策略。MetaFine进一步支持混合现实-仿真验证，利用有限配对现实部署数据来校准可扩展的仿真评估，实现更稳定的物理基准测试。通过将评估重心从排名转向诊断，MetaFine将基准测试转化为可操作的指南，用于修复真实物理灵巧性背后的分层能力。MetaFine框架、基准测试及配套资源将在项目页面公开发布：https://metafine.github.io/。

Authors: He-Yang Xu, Pengyuan Zhang, Zongyuan Ge, Xiaoshuai Hao, Serge Belongie, Xin Geng, Yuxin Peng, Xiu-Shen Wei

CEER: Compliant End-Effector and Root Control as a Unified Interface for Hierarchical Humanoid Loco-Manipulation HumanoidEmbodied

compliant whole-body control hierarchical planning humanoid loco-manipulation teacher-student framework contact-rich manipulation

简要说明：CEER提出了一种用于人形机器人运动操作的人机兼容的末端执行器-根基控制抽象，支持模块化的、与规划器兼容的全身控制，实现稳定的接触式操作。

TLDR: CEER proposes a compliant end-effector-root control abstraction for humanoid loco-manipulation, enabling modular, planner-compatible whole-body control and stable contact-rich manipulation.

Abstract: Humanoid robots have achieved impressive locomotion performance, yet contact-rich and long-horizon manipulation remains a major bottleneck. Manipulation is inherently contact-rich and demands compliant whole-body control for stable interaction, while its diversity and long-horizon nature favor modular, planner-compatible interfaces over joint-space tracking. We propose CEER, a compliant end-effector-root (EE-root) control abstraction for modular humanoid loco-manipulation within a hierarchical planning framework. CEER enables compliance-aware whole-body control in an interpretable task space defined by root motion commands and end-effector pose targets, and supports plug-and-play integration with heterogeneous high-level planners. A teacher-student framework is adopted to distill a general motion-tracking controller into a low-level policy that consumes only EE-root commands. We further construct a hierarchical system that integrates heterogeneous planners and task modules through the EE-root interface, enabling diverse manipulation tasks without retraining the underlying whole-body policy. Experiments in simulation and on hardware demonstrate 3.3 cm end-effector tracking accuracy with substantially reduced jerk compared to baselines, stable contact-rich manipulation under teleoperation, and up to 70% success in simulated single-object loco-manipulation tasks within a room-scale environment. These results indicate that compliant EE-root control provides a practical abstraction for humanoid loco-manipulation, enabling modular and scalable integration of diverse skills.

摘要（中文）：人形机器人已实现卓越的运动能力，但依赖大量接触的长期操作任务仍是主要瓶颈。操作行为天然涉及密集接触，需要顺应性全身控制以实现稳定交互，而其多样性与长期性特点更适宜采用模块化、兼容规划器的接口，而非关节空间轨迹跟踪。 我们提出CEER（顺应性末端执行器-本体控制抽象）方法，在分层规划框架内实现模块化人形机器人运动操作一体化控制。CEER在由本体运动指令与末端执行器姿态目标构成的可解释任务空间中实现顺应感知的全身控制，并支持与异构高层规划器的即插即用集成。通过师生框架将通用运动跟踪控制器提炼为仅需末端执行器-本体指令的低层策略。 我们进一步构建了通过末端执行器-本体接口集成异构规划器与任务模块的分层系统，无需重新训练底层全身策略即可完成多样化操作任务。仿真与硬件实验表明：相比基线方法，末端执行器轨迹跟踪精度达到3.3厘米且急动度显著降低；遥操作下实现稳定的密集接触操作；在房间尺度环境中单物体运动操作任务成功率最高达70%。这些结果表明，顺应性末端执行器-本体控制为人形机器人运动操作提供了实用抽象，实现了多样化技能的模块化可扩展集成。

Authors: Xinyuan Luo, Xingrui Chen, Xunjian Yin, Hongxuan Wu, Boxi Xia, Zhuoqun Chen, Jinzhou Li, Boyuan Chen, Xianyi Cheng

World-Ego Modeling for Long-Horizon Evolution in Hybrid Embodied Tasks WorldModel

world-ego modeling long-horizon hybrid tasks diffusion generator navigation-manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了世界-自我建模范式，将世界和自我动态解耦以处理长时程具身任务，并实例化为世界-自我模型（WEM）及新基准HTEWorld。

TLDR: The paper introduces World-Ego Modeling, a paradigm that disentangles world and ego dynamics for long-horizon embodied tasks, and instantiates it as the World-Ego Model (WEM) with a new benchmark, HTEWorld.

Abstract: World models are widely explored in embodied intelligence, yet they typically predict distinct evolutions of the world and the ego within a single stream, where the world captures persistent instruction-agnostic scene regularities and the ego captures robot-centric instruction-conditioned dynamics. This world-ego entanglement leads to a degradation in long-horizon embodied scenarios, particularly in hybrid tasks with interleaved navigation and manipulation behaviors. In this paper, we introduce \emph{World-Ego Modeling}, a new conceptual paradigm that decomposes future evolution into world and ego components. We define the world-ego boundary from three perspectives, i.e., motion-, semantic-, and intention-based views, and analyze three disentanglement strategies with post-, pre-, and full disentanglement. Further, we instantiate this paradigm as the World-Ego Model (WEM), a unified embodied world model that couples an implicit separate world-ego planner with a cascade-parallel mixture-of-experts (CP-MoE) diffusion generator. To enable rigorous evaluation, we further construct HTEWorld, the first benchmark for long-horizon world modeling with hybrid navigation-manipulation tasks, providing 125K video clips (over 4.5M frames) with fine-grained action annotations and 300 multi-turn evaluation trajectories (over 2K instructions). Extensive experiments show that WEM achieves state-of-the-art performance on HTEWorld while remaining competitive on existing manipulation-only benchmarks.

摘要（中文）：世界模型在具身智能领域得到广泛探索，但其通常以单一流式框架预测世界与自我主体的独立演化过程——其中世界表征持久的、与指令无关的场景规律，自我主体则捕捉以机器人为中心的指令条件动态。这种世界-自我纠缠会导致长视野具身场景性能下降，尤其在导航与操作行为交织的混合任务中。本文提出**世界-自我建模**这一新范式，将未来演化过程解耦为世界与自我两个组成部分。我们基于运动、语义和意图三个视角界定世界-自我边界，并通过后解耦、前解耦与全解耦三种策略进行解构分析。进一步地，我们将该范式实例化为世界-自我模型（WEM）：一个耦合了隐式分离式世界-自我规划器与级联并行混合专家（CP-MoE）扩散生成器的统一具身世界模型。为建立严谨评估体系，我们构建了首个面向混合导航-操作任务的长视野世界建模基准HTEWorld，包含12.5万段视频片段（超450万帧）的细粒度动作标注以及300条多轮评估轨迹（超2000条指令）。大量实验表明，WEM在HTEWorld基准上达到最先进性能，同时在现有纯操作基准上保持竞争力。

Authors: Zuyao Lin, Jianhui Zhang, Peidong Jia, Xiaoguang Zhao, Shanghang Zhang, Xingyu Chen

Beyond Imitation: Learning Safe End-to-End Autonomous Driving from Hard Negatives AutonomousDriving

end-to-end autonomous driving imitation learning hard negative trajectories safety-aware learning closed-loop simulation

简要说明：该论文提出了一种用于自动驾驶的失败感知模仿学习框架，通过同时学习专家演示和合成的困难负面轨迹来改善安全性，并在闭环基准测试中取得了领先性能。

TLDR: The paper proposes BeyondDrive, a failure-aware imitation learning framework for autonomous driving that learns from both expert demonstrations and synthesized hard negative trajectories to improve safety, achieving state-of-the-art closed-loop performance.

Abstract: Existing imitation learning methods for end-to-end autonomous driving predominantly learn from successful demonstrations by minimizing geometric deviations from expert trajectories. This paradigm implicitly assumes that spatial proximity implies behavioral safety, leading to a critical objective mismatch: trajectories with nearly identical imitation losses may exhibit drastically different safety outcomes, where one remains recoverable while the other results in collision. To address this limitation, we propose BeyondDrive, a failure-aware imitation learning framework that jointly learns from successful and failed driving behaviors. First, we introduce a flow matching-based negative trajectory generator that synthesizes safety-critical yet expert-proximate trajectories, enabling explicit modeling of safety asymmetry. Second, we develop a diversity-aware sampling strategy that mitigates mode collapse and improves coverage of diverse failure modes during negative trajectory generation. Third, we propose a Repulsive Distance Loss that simultaneously attracts predictions toward expert demonstrations while repelling them from hard negative trajectories, thereby establishing discriminative safety boundaries in trajectory space. Applied to the uni-modal baseline Latent TransFuser, BeyondDrive achieves 89.7 PDMS on the NAVSIMv1 closed-loop benchmark, outperforming prior state-of-the-art methods. Moreover, BeyondDrive generalizes effectively across different autonomous driving architectures, including multi-modal planners, and further demonstrates strong zero-shot transferability on the HUGSIM benchmark.

摘要（中文）：现有端到端自动驾驶的模仿学习方法主要通过学习成功演示，最小化与专家轨迹的几何偏差来学习。这种范式隐含地假设空间接近性意味着行为安全性，导致了一个关键的目标错配：具有几乎相同模仿损失的两个轨迹，可能表现出截然不同的安全结果，其中一个仍可恢复正常行驶，而另一个却会导致碰撞。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了BeyondDrive——一种故障感知的模仿学习框架，能够同时从成功和失败的驾驶行为中学习。首先，我们引入了一种基于流匹配的负轨迹生成器，用于合成安全关键且接近专家轨迹的负样本，从而实现对安全不对称性的显式建模。其次，我们开发了一种多样性感知的采样策略，以缓解模式坍塌问题，并在负轨迹生成过程中提高对多种故障模式的覆盖范围。第三，我们提出了一种排斥距离损失函数，该函数在将预测轨迹向专家演示轨迹吸引的同时，使其远离难以处理的负轨迹，从而在轨迹空间中建立具有区分性的安全边界。将BeyondDrive应用于单模态基线模型Latent TransFuser后，在NAVSIMv1闭环基准测试中取得了89.7 PDMS的分数，超越了先前的最先进方法。此外，BeyondDrive能够有效推广到不同的自动驾驶架构中，包括多模态规划器，并进一步在HUGSIM基准测试中展现出强大的零样本可迁移性。

Authors: Junli Wang, Zhihua Hua, Xueyi Liu, Zebin Xing, Haochen Tian, Kun Ma, Hangjun Ye, Guang Chen, Long Chen, Qichao Zhang

RoVLA: Multi-Consistency Constraints for Robust Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

Vision-Language-Action models robustness consistency constraints embodied manipulation invariance learning

简要说明：RoVLA 提出多一致性约束（指令、演化和观测一致性），以增强视觉-语言-动作模型在指令、视觉观测和轨迹生成扰动下的鲁棒性。

TLDR: RoVLA proposes multi-consistency constraints (instructional, evolutionary, observational) to improve the robustness of Vision-Language-Action models against perturbations in instructions, visual observations, and trajectory generation.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong performance on embodied manipulation, yet they remain brittle under visual observation changes, paraphrased language instructions, and compounded perturbations. This limitation suggests that existing methods still rely heavily on shallow correlations in the training distribution, rather than learning stable couplings among task semantics, environment states, and action generation. Although recent efforts improve robustness through larger-scale training, post-training adaptation, or enhanced predictive modeling, they rarely enforce invariance-oriented consistency within the end-to-end policy itself. To address this issue, we propose RoVLA, a robust vision-language-action framework with multi-consistency constraints. RoVLA enforces consistency under three complementary transformations: instruction semantics, trajectory evolution, and observation perturbation. Specifically, Instructional Consistency (IC) promotes stable grounding under semantically equivalent instruction rewrites, Evolutionary Consistency (EC) preserves coherent action intent throughout the generation process, and Observational Consistency (OC) improves robustness to visual and proprioceptive perturbations by enforcing consistent predictions before and after targeted disturbances. By explicitly modeling these invariances during training, RoVLA reduces reliance on superficial correlations and improves robustness and generalization. Experiments on LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world manipulation tasks show that RoVLA consistently outperforms strong baseline methods and exhibits superior robustness under diverse task and observation shifts. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of multi-consistency learning for robust embodied control. Codes will be available at https://github.com/HCPLab-SYSU/RoVLA.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在具身操作任务中表现出强大的性能，但在视觉观察变化、语言指令重述以及复合扰动下仍显脆弱。这一局限性表明，现有方法仍然严重依赖训练分布中的浅层关联，而非学习任务语义、环境状态与动作生成之间的稳定耦合。尽管近期研究通过更大规模训练、训练后适应或增强预测建模来提升鲁棒性，但很少在端到端策略内部强制实施以不变性为导向的一致性约束。为应对这一问题，本文提出RoVLA——一个具有多一致性约束的鲁棒视觉-语言-动作框架。RoVLA在三类互补变换下强制实施一致性：指令语义、轨迹演化和观察扰动。具体而言，指令一致性（IC）在语义等价指令重述下促进稳定语义落地；演化一致性（EC）在整个生成过程中保持连贯的动作意图；观察一致性（OC）通过强制模型在目标扰动前后作出一致预测，提升对视觉及本体感受扰动的鲁棒性。通过在训练中显式建模这些不变性，RoVLA减少了对表层关联的依赖，并提升了鲁棒性与泛化能力。在LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0以及真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，RoVLA始终优于强基线方法，并在多样化的任务与观察偏移下展现出更优越的鲁棒性。这些结果证明了多一致性学习对鲁棒具身控制的有效性。代码将在https://github.com/HCPLab-SYSU/RoVLA发布。

Authors: Jingzhou Luo, Yifan Wen, Yongjie Bai, Xinshuai Song, Yang Liu, Liang Lin

HEAT: Heterogeneous End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Trajectory-Guided World Models AutonomousDriving

end-to-end autonomous driving multi-domain learning trajectory-guided world model heterogeneous domains

简要说明：提出了一种轨迹驱动的学习范式和世界模型，使端到端自动驾驶模型能够在异构数据集上有效训练，无需针对特定领域进行重新训练即可实现强大的多领域性能。

TLDR: Proposes a trajectory-driven learning paradigm and a world model to enable end-to-end autonomous driving models to train effectively on heterogeneous datasets, achieving strong multi-domain performance without domain-specific retraining.

Abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving has emerged as a compelling alternative to traditional modular pipelines by directly mapping raw sensor data to driving actions. While recent approaches achieve strong performance on single-domain datasets, their performance degrades significantly when trained jointly across multiple heterogeneous domains. In practice, however, autonomous systems must operate across diverse environments with heterogeneous distributions, including different cities, sensor configurations, and traffic patterns, without domain-specific retraining. This gap highlights a key challenge in multi-domain learning: domain-specific variations across heterogeneous domains introduce conflicting learning signals, driving models toward compromised solutions that are suboptimal across domains. To address this, we propose a trajectory-driven learning paradigm that organizes training around planning trajectories, enabling the model to capture domain-invariant representations of driving intent. Furthermore, we incorporate a world model that predicts future latent features conditioned on ego actions, improving feature consistency and mitigating domain-induced biases. We evaluate our approach on three benchmarks, nuScenes, NAVSIM, and the Waymo end-to-end dataset, and show substantial improvements over existing methods across all domains. Our results demonstrate that a single unified model can be trained on heterogeneous datasets while maintaining strong performance within each domain, highlighting a step toward scalable real-world deployment. We will make our code publicly available.

摘要（中文）：端到端自动驾驶系统通过直接将原始传感器数据映射为驾驶行为，成为传统模块化流程的重要替代方案。尽管现有方法在单域数据集上表现优异，但在跨多个异构域联合训练时性能显著下降。然而在实际应用中，自动驾驶系统必须能够适应分布异构的多样化环境——包括不同城市、传感器配置和交通模式，且无需进行特定域重训练。这一差距揭示了多域学习中的关键挑战：异构域间特定域差异会产生相互冲突的学习信号，导致模型趋向于折衷的次优解决方案。为此，我们提出轨迹驱动的学习范式，围绕规划轨迹组织训练，使模型能够捕获驾驶意图的域不变表征。此外，我们引入基于自车动作预测未来潜在特征的世界模型，以提升特征一致性并缓解域偏差影响。我们在三个基准测试（nuScenes、NAVSIM和Waymo端到端数据集）上验证了所提方法，结果表明其在所有域上均显著优于现有方法。我们的研究证明，单一统一模型能够在异构数据集上进行训练，同时保持各域内的强大性能，这标志着向可扩展现实部署迈出了重要一步。相关代码将公开发布。

Authors: Hoonhee Cho, Giwon Lee, Jae-Young Kang, Hyemin Yang, Heejun Park, Kuk-Jin Yoon

Implicit Action Chunking for Smooth Continuous Control AutonomousDriving

continuous control action chunking temporal coherence autonomous driving reinforcement learning

简要说明：提出双窗口平滑（DWS），一种隐式动作分块框架，在不扩大动作空间的情况下强制执行时间一致性以实现平滑连续控制，在机器人和自动驾驶任务上提升了性能。

TLDR: Proposes Dual-Window Smoothing (DWS), an implicit action chunking framework that enforces temporal coherence for smooth continuous control without expanding the action space, improving performance on robotics and autonomous driving tasks.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning often produces high-frequency oscillatory control signals that undermine the safety and stability required for physical deployment. Explicit action chunking addresses this by predicting fixed-horizon trajectories but scales the policy output dimension proportionally with the horizon length, leading to optimization difficulties and incompatibility with standard step-wise interaction. To overcome these challenges, this paper proposes Dual-Window Smoothing (DWS), an implicit action chunking framework for smooth continuous control. Unlike explicit methods, DWS enforces temporal coherence without expanding the action space. It uses a dual-window design: an execution window that ensures physical smoothness through deterministic modulation, and a value window that aligns temporal-difference targets over the horizon to correct critic bias caused by open-loop execution. DWS also includes a lightweight actor-side temporal regularizer based on first-order action differences to promote global continuity. This design effectively bridges the gap between temporal abstraction and reactive step-wise control. Experiments on benchmarks including the DeepMind Control Suite and industrial energy management tasks show that DWS outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines. In complex vision-based autonomous driving tasks, DWS achieves smoother control, safer behavior with reduced jitter, and attains a 100% success rate.

摘要（中文）：强化学习在物理系统部署时常产生高频振荡控制信号，这对安全性及稳定性构成挑战。显式动作分块通过预测固定时间范围内的轨迹来解决此问题，但会使策略输出维度随预测时长线性增长，导致优化困难且与标准逐步交互模式不兼容。为克服这些挑战，本文提出双窗口平滑（DWS）框架，这是一种实现平滑连续控制的隐式动作分块方法。与显式方法不同，DWS在无需扩展动作空间的前提下增强了时间连贯性。该框架采用双窗口设计：执行窗口通过确定性调制确保物理平滑性，价值窗口则通过在时间范围内对齐时序差分目标来修正开环执行引起的评价器偏差。此外，DWS引入基于一阶动作差异的轻量级执行器端时序正则化器，以提升全局连续性。该设计有效弥合了时间抽象与反应式逐步控制之间的鸿沟。在DeepMind控制套件及工业能源管理任务等基准测试中，DWS均优于当前最先进基线方法。在基于视觉的复杂自动驾驶任务中，DWS实现了更平滑的控制、降低抖动后的安全行为，并达成100%的成功率。

Authors: Bosun Liang, Shuo Pei, Zirui Chen, Chuanzhi Fan, Chen Sun, Yuankai Wu, Huachun Tan, Yong Wang

PAPO-VLA: Planning-Aware Policy Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

Vision-Language-Action models planning actions policy optimization causal sufficiency closed-loop interaction

简要说明：PAPO-VLA通过因果重要性识别并强调规划动作，提升VLA策略的可靠性，从而增强了闭环机器人操作的性能。

TLDR: PAPO-VLA improves VLA policy reliability by identifying and emphasizing planning actions using causal importance, enhancing closed-loop robotic manipulation performance.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models show promising ability in language-guided robotic tasks. However, making VLA policies reliable remains challenging, because a manipulation task is completed through closed-loop interaction, where each action affects subsequent execution. To analyze this problem, we revisit VLA policy during execution and argue that a VLA policy acts both as a planner, which makes task-oriented decisions that change the direction of execution, and as an executor, which realizes these decisions through dense continuous actions. This view suggests that improving VLA reliability requires particular attention to planning actions. Existing optimization methods can imitate actions or improve complete trajectories, but they usually do not explicitly identify planning actions or measure their importance for task success. To address this issue, we propose Planning-Aware Policy Optimization for VLA models (PAPO-VLA). PAPO-VLA first identifies planning actions by jointly considering action variation and trajectory outcome, then estimates their importance through causal sufficiency and causal necessity, and finally incorporates this importance into GRPO advantage estimation. In this way, more important planning actions receive stronger optimization emphasis, while the whole trajectory is still optimized by trajectory-level feedback. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of PAPO-VLA.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作模型在语言引导的机器人任务中展现出良好的应用潜力。然而，要使VLA策略具备可靠性仍面临挑战，因为操作任务的完成依赖于闭环交互过程，其中每个动作都会影响后续执行。为分析这一问题，本文重新审视了VLA策略在执行过程中的作用，认为VLA策略同时承担着规划者与执行者的双重角色：作为规划者，它做出改变执行方向的任务导向决策；作为执行者，它通过密集的连续动作实现这些决策。这一视角表明，提升VLA可靠性需要特别关注规划动作。现有优化方法虽能模仿动作或改进完整轨迹，但通常不会显式识别规划动作，亦未衡量其对任务成功的重要性。针对此问题，我们提出面向VLA模型的规划感知策略优化方法。该方法首先通过联合考虑动作变化与轨迹结果来识别规划动作，继而通过因果充分性与因果必要性评估其重要性，最终将重要性度量融入GRPO优势估计中。通过这种方式，更重要的规划动作将获得更强的优化权重，而整个轨迹仍通过轨迹级反馈进行优化。在多基准测试上的实验验证了该方法的有效性。

Authors: Peizheng Guo, Jingyao Wang, Changwen Zheng, Wenwen Qiang

SafeAlign-VLA: A Negative-Enhanced Safe Alignment Framework for Risk-Aware Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

Vision-Language-Action Safe Alignment Negative Data Counterfactual Reasoning Policy Optimization

简要说明：提出SafeAlign-VLA，一种用于自动驾驶的基于负样本增强的安全对齐框架，该框架通过反事实推理将风险数据整合到监督学习和强化学习中，提高了安全性和性能。

TLDR: Proposes SafeAlign-VLA, a negative-enhanced safe alignment framework for autonomous driving that leverages counterfactual reasoning to incorporate risky data into supervised and reinforcement learning, improving safety and performance.

Abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving systems excel in common scenarios but struggle with safety-critical long-tail cases. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are promising due to their strong reasoning capabilities. However, most VLA-based approaches rely on positive expert demonstrations, rarely exploiting negative samples, leading to insufficient understanding of risky behaviors and safety boundaries. To address this limitation, we propose SafeAlign-VLA, a unified negative-enhanced safe alignment framework that incorporates negative data into supervised learning and reinforcement learning. First, we develop a counterfactual safety pairing paradigm to generate structured safety labels and counterfactual positive trajectories from risky scenarios via counterfactual reasoning. Then, a two-stage training strategy is adopted: negative-enhanced supervised fine-tuning for failure feedback and trajectory correction, followed by anchor-based group relative policy optimization that uses positive and negative trajectories as contrastive anchors to steer sampling and penalize high-risk behaviors via group-relative advantages. Experiments on NAVSIM and DeepAccident validate the proposed framework. SafeAlign-VLA achieves 89.1 PDMS on the NAVSIM v1 testset, improving over the baseline without negative data by 1.3%. On DeepAccident, it reduces the collision rate to 3.36%, while achieving 84.2% language accuracy and 85.8% risk prediction accuracy. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed negative-enhanced safe alignment framework for safe and robust autonomous driving.

摘要（中文）：端到端自动驾驶系统在常规场景中表现优异，但在安全关键的长尾场景中面临挑战。视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型凭借强大的推理能力展现出广阔前景。然而，现有基于VLA的方法大多依赖正向专家示范，极少利用负向样本，导致对风险行为及安全边界的理解不足。为突破这一局限，本文提出SafeAlign-VLA——一种统一的负向增强安全对齐框架，将负向数据整合至监督学习与强化学习中。首先，我们设计了反事实安全配对范式，通过反事实推理从风险场景中生成结构化安全标签及反事实正向轨迹。随后采用两阶段训练策略：先通过负向增强的监督微调实现故障反馈与轨迹校正，再采用基于锚点的分组相对策略优化，将正负轨迹作为对比锚点引导采样，并通过分组相对优势惩罚高风险行为。在NAVSIM和DeepAccident数据集上的实验验证了该框架的有效性：SafeAlign-VLA在NAVSIM v1测试集上达到89.1%的PDMS分数，较未使用负向数据的基线提升1.3%；在DeepAccident数据集上，碰撞率降至3.36%，同时实现84.2%的语言理解准确率与85.8%的风险预测准确率。这些结果证明了所提出的负向增强安全对齐框架能够有效提升自动驾驶系统的安全性与鲁棒性。

Authors: Kefei Tian, Yuansheng Lian, Kai Yang, Xiangdong Chen, Shen Li

Closed-Loop Hybrid Digital Twin Platform for Connected and Automated Vehicle Validation AutonomousDriving

hybrid digital twin closed-loop control connected and automated vehicles CARLA-SUMO co-simulation V2X communication

简要说明：提出了一个实时混合数字孪生平台，通过V2X将高保真仿真（CARLA-SUMO）与物理测试车辆紧密耦合，用于网联自动驾驶汽车的闭环验证。

TLDR: Proposes a real-time hybrid digital twin platform that tightly couples a high-fidelity simulation (CARLA-SUMO) with a physical test vehicle via V2X for closed-loop validation of connected and automated vehicles.

Abstract: Comprehensive and efficient validation of connected and automated vehicles (CAVs) is critical prior to real-world deployment. While simulation-based testing offers scalability, existing approaches often lack seamless integration with real vehicles and field data, limiting their fidelity in capturing dynamic, real-world interactions. To bridge this gap, this paper proposes a novel real-time hybrid digital twin platform. Its core innovation lies in the tight coupling of a high-fidelity CARLA-SUMO co-simulation with a physical test site and vehicle via a low-latency Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communication link. A custom-developed middleware serves as the critical bridge, synchronizing a real CAV's kinematic state as a shadow vehicle in the simulation and translating virtual control commands into chassis-actuating Controller Area Network (CAN) messages for closed-loop control. Detailed implementation includes using photogrammetry for full-scale asset reconstruction and a cloud-edge collaborative architecture for scalable, multi-user operation. Experimental results demonstrate stable synchronization and effective closed-loop control with low latency, confirming the platform's practicality for multi-scenario CAV verification.

摘要（中文）：连接与自动驾驶车辆（CAV）在真实部署前需进行全面高效的验证。尽管基于仿真的测试具备可扩展性，但现有方法往往缺乏与真实车辆及实地数据的无缝集成，限制了其在捕捉动态真实世界交互时的逼真度。为弥合这一差距，本文提出了一种新颖的实时混合数字孪生平台。其核心创新在于通过低延迟的车联网（V2X）通信链路，将高保真CARLA-SUMO联合仿真与物理测试场地及实体车辆紧密耦合。自主开发的中间件作为关键桥梁，实时同步真实CAV的运动状态作为仿真中的影子车辆，并将虚拟控制指令转换为底盘驱动的控制器局域网（CAN）报文，实现闭环控制。具体实施方案包括采用摄影测量技术进行全尺寸实体场景重建，以及应用云边协同架构支持可扩展的多用户操作。实验结果证实，平台在低延迟条件下实现了稳定的同步与有效的闭环控制，验证了该平台在多场景CAV验证中的实用性。

Authors: Kanglong Quan, Zhebing Xia, Linfeng Jiang, Hao Yu, Ziheng Qiao, Dapeng Dong, Dongyao Jia

DEFLECT: Delay-Robust Execution via Flow-matching Likelihood-Estimated Counterfactual Tuning for VLA Policies VLA

asynchronous inference delay-robust execution flow-matching counterfactual tuning offline refinement

简要说明：DEFLECT是一种离线后训练方法，通过将延迟本身用作无标签偏好信号，利用流匹配似然比代理，提升视觉-语言-动作策略在异步执行下的鲁棒性，显著扩展了高延迟下的可用延迟范围。

TLDR: DEFLECT is an offline post-training method that improves asynchronous execution of Vision-Language-Action policies by using delay-induced action pairs and a flow-matching likelihood surrogate, enabling robust control under high latency without labels or online rollouts.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are typically deployed with asynchronous inference: the robot executes a previously predicted action chunk while the model computes the next one. This creates a prediction-execution misalignment: the chunk is conditioned on the observation taken before inference began, but executes in a physical state that has already drifted forward by several control steps; naive asynchronous rollover collapses from 89% to under 1% on Kinetix as the inference cycle covers up to seven control steps. We introduce DEFLECT, a fully offline post-training refinement that applies as a near drop-in upgrade to existing async-VLA stacks by converting latency itself into a label-free preference signal: counterfactual fresh/stale action pairs are constructed from a frozen reference policy and scored under the deployment-time conditioning via an implicit flow-matching likelihood-ratio surrogate, with no human labels, reward models, or online rollouts. DEFLECT substantially extends the usable delay envelope of async VLA control, with +6.4 success-rate gain in the high-latency regime (5-7 control steps), +4.6 when transferred to a real-scale VLA at the longest delay, and consistent improvements on two real-robot tasks (a bimanual conveyor pick-and-place and a reactive whack-a-mole).

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通常采用异步推理进行部署：机器人在模型计算下一动作序列时执行先前预测的动作块。这导致了预测与执行的错位：动作块基于推理开始前获取的观测信息进行条件化，但实际执行时物理状态已向前漂移了多个控制步长；当推理周期覆盖多达七个控制步长时，在Kinetix数据集上，简单异步滚动的成功率从89%骤降至不足1%。我们提出了DEFLECT方法，这是一种完全离线的训练后优化技术，可作为一种几乎无需修改的升级应用于现有异步VLA系统，通过将延迟本身转化为无标签的偏好信号：利用冻结参考策略构建反事实的"新鲜/陈旧"动作对，并在部署时条件下通过隐式流匹配似然比代理进行评分，无需人工标注、奖励模型或在线试运行。DEFLECT显著扩展了异步VLA控制的可容忍延迟范围，在高延迟场景（5-7个控制步长）中成功率提升+6.4%，在最长延迟下迁移至真实尺度VLA时提升+4.6%，并在两个真实机器人任务（双手传送带抓放与反应式打地鼠任务）中实现持续的性能改进。

Authors: Yixiang Zhu, Yonghao Chen, Rui Meng, Jingyu Guo, Jiaxiang Zou, Zijie Yang, Taowen Wang, Xinyu Chen

CLUE: Adaptively Prioritized Contextual Cues by Leveraging a Unified Semantic Map for Effective Zero-Shot Object-Goal Navigation VLN

zero-shot object-goal navigation contextual cues unified semantic map large language model adaptive exploration

简要说明：提出了一种零样本目标物体导航框架，利用基于大语言模型的常识先验和统一的语义图，自适应地优先处理房间或物体上下文线索。

TLDR: Proposes a zero-shot object-goal navigation framework that adaptively prioritizes room or object contextual cues using an LLM-based commonsense prior and a unified semantic map.

Abstract: Zero-shot object-goal navigation (ZSON) is a challenging problem in robotics that requires a comprehensive understanding of both language and visual observations. Contextual cues from rooms and objects are critical, but their relative importance depends on the target: some objects are strongly tied to specific room types, while others are better predicted by nearby co-located objects. Existing methods overlook this distinction, leading to inefficient and inaccurate exploration. We present CLUE, a novel navigation framework that adaptively balances the use of contextual rooms and objects by leveraging commonsense knowledge extracted from an offline large language model (LLM). By estimating a target's association with room types using LLM, the agent prioritizes room cues for predictable objects and object cues for those with weak room associations. Our framework constructs a unified semantic value map that integrates both types of contextual information, adaptively weighted by the target's ambiguity to guide exploration. Combined with multi-viewpoint verification and an exploration strategy informed by contextual cues, CLUE achieves robust and efficient navigation. Extensive experiments in simulation and real-world deployments show that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both success rate (SR) and success weighted by path length (SPL), demonstrating its effectiveness and practicality for real-world navigation tasks.

摘要（中文）：零样本目标导航是机器人学中的一个挑战性难题，它要求对语言和视觉观察信息进行综合理解。来自房间和物体的上下文线索至关重要，但它们的相对重要性取决于具体目标：某些物体与特定房间类型紧密相关，而另一些物体则更适合通过邻近的共置物体进行预测。现有方法忽略了这一区别，导致探索效率低下且准确性不足。我们提出了CLUE，一种新颖的导航框架，通过利用从离线大型语言模型中提取的常识知识，自适应地平衡上下文房间与物体线索的使用。通过使用LLM评估目标与房间类型的关联度，智能体可为可预测物体优先考虑房间线索，而对房间关联较弱的物体则侧重物体线索。我们的框架构建了一个统一的语义价值地图，整合了两种类型的上下文信息，并根据目标对象的模糊性进行自适应加权以引导探索。结合多视角验证及基于上下文线索的探索策略，CLUE实现了稳健高效的导航。在仿真环境和实际部署中进行的大量实验表明，我们的方法在成功率（SR）和路径长度加权成功率（SPL）上均持续优于现有先进基线模型，证明了其在实际导航任务中的有效性和实用性。

Authors: Taeyun Kim, Alvin Jinsung Choi, Dasol Hong, Hyun Myung

Guiding Neuro-Symbolic Scenario Generation with Spatio-Temporal Logic AutonomousDriving

scenario generation spatio-temporal logic diffusion model safety-critical autonomous driving

简要说明：提出STRELGen框架，利用可微分的时空逻辑指导扩散模型，有针对性地生成安全关键的驾驶场景，用于高效的压力测试自动驾驶系统。

TLDR: Proposes STRELGen, a framework for targeted generation of safety-critical driving scenarios using a differentiable spatio-temporal logic to guide a diffusion model, enabling efficient stress-testing of autonomous driving systems.

Abstract: The rapid advancement of autonomous driving (AD) technologies has outpaced the development of robust safety evaluation methods. Conventional testing relies on exposing AD systems to vast numbers of real-world traffic scenes -- a brute-force approach that is prohibitively expensive and statistically ineffective at capturing the rare, safety-critical edge cases essential for validating real-world robustness. To address this fundamental limitation, we introduce STRELGen, a scalable framework for the targeted generation of safety-critical driving scenarios. STRELGen synergistically combines a multi-agent trajectory-generation diffusion model (DM) with Spatio-Temporal Logic (STREL) specifications that encode complex safety and realism properties through a highly interpretable formalism. Crucially, monitoring satisfaction levels of these specifications is differentiable, enabling gradient-based search. At inference time, we optimize directly over the DM latent space to maximize STREL formula satisfaction. The result is efficient generation of highly plausible yet safety-critical multi-agent scenarios that lie within the learned data distribution. STRELGen thus provides a flexible, interpretable, and powerful tool for stress-testing autonomous driving systems, moving beyond the limitations of brute-force data collection.

摘要（中文）：自动驾驶技术的飞速发展已超越稳健安全评估方法的研发进程。传统测试方法依赖于让自动驾驶系统接触海量真实交通场景，这种"暴力"方法不仅成本高昂，且在统计层面难以有效捕获验证实际鲁棒性所必需的关键性罕见边界案例。为突破这一根本性局限，我们提出STRELGen——一个面向安全关键驾驶场景定向生成的可扩展框架。该框架创新性地将多智能体轨迹生成扩散模型与时空逻辑规范相结合，通过高度可解释的形式化方法编码复杂的安全性与真实性要求。其关键在于对规范满足度的监测具备可微分特性，从而实现基于梯度的搜索优化。在推理阶段，我们直接在扩散模型潜空间上进行优化，以最大化时空逻辑公式的满足度。最终实现高效生成既高度符合学习数据分布又具备安全关键性的多智能体场景。STRELGen由此为自动驾驶系统压力测试提供了一种灵活、可解释且功能强大的工具，突破了传统数据收集方法的局限性。

Authors: Lorenzo Bonin, Francesco Giacomarra, Luca Bortolussi, Jyotirmoy V. Deshmukh, Francesca Cairoli

VL-DPO: Vision-Language-Guided Finetuning for Preference-Aligned Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

motion forecasting vision-language models preference alignment Direct Preference Optimization autonomous driving

简要说明：本文提出了VL-DPO框架，利用视觉语言模型作为零样本推理器，从预训练模型生成偏好对，通过直接偏好优化（DPO）对驾驶运动预测模型进行微调，使其与人类偏好对齐，并在驾驶数据集上提升了偏好评分和轨迹精度。

TLDR: This paper introduces VL-DPO, a vision-language-guided framework that aligns ego-vehicle motion forecasting models with human preferences by using a VLM to generate preference pairs for Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) finetuning, improving preference and accuracy metrics on a driving dataset.

Abstract: The rapid growth of autonomous driving datasets has enabled the scaling of powerful motion forecasting models. While large-scale pretraining provides strong performance, the standard imitation objective may not fully capture the complex nuances of human driving preferences. Meanwhile, recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning and commonsense understanding. Building on these capabilities, this paper presents VL-DPO, a vision-language-guided framework that aligns ego-vehicle motion forecasting models with human preferences. Our approach leverages a VLM as a zero-shot reasoner to automatically generate preference pairs from a pretrained model's rollouts, which are then used to finetune the model via Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). We finetune our models on the Waymo Open End-to-End Driving Dataset (WOD-E2E) and evaluate performance against held-out human preference annotations using rater feedback score (RFS) and average displacement error (ADE). Our experiments confirm that the VLM's trajectory selection is a high-quality proxy for human preference. Our final model, VL-DPO, yields an 11.94% increase in RFS and a 10.01% reduction in ADE over the pretrained model.

摘要（中文）：自动驾驶数据集的快速增长为强大的运动预测模型规模化奠定了基础。虽然大规模预训练提供了卓越性能，但标准的模仿学习目标可能无法完整捕捉人类驾驶偏好中复杂的细微差别。与此同时，视觉语言模型（VLM）的最新进展已展现出卓越的推理和常识理解能力。基于这些能力，本文提出VL-DPO——一种通过视觉语言引导的自车运动预测模型与人类偏好对齐的框架。该方法利用VLM作为零样本推理器，从预训练模型的轨迹推演中自动生成偏好对，随后通过直接偏好优化（DPO）对模型进行微调。我们在Waymo开放端到端驾驶数据集（WOD-E2E）上对模型进行微调，并通过评估员反馈分数（RFS）与平均位移误差（ADE）指标，与保留的人类偏好标注数据进行性能对比。实验证实，VLM的轨迹选择能作为人类偏好的高质量代理。最终模型VL-DPO相比预训练模型实现了11.94%的RFS提升与10.01%的ADE降低。

Authors: Zhefan Xu, Ghassen Jerfel, Marina Haliem, Qi Zhao, Jeonhyung Kang, Khaled S. Refaat

Co-Fusion4D: Spatio-temporal Collaborative Fusion for Robust 3D Object Detection AutonomousDriving

3D object detection spatio-temporal fusion BEV representation temporal alignment autonomous driving perception

简要说明：该论文提出了Co-Fusion4D，一种用于自动驾驶中稳健3D物体检测的时空协同融合框架，旨在解决BEV表示中的时序错位和特征漂移问题，并在nuScenes基准上取得了最先进的性能。

TLDR: The paper proposes Co-Fusion4D, a spatio-temporal collaborative fusion framework for robust 3D object detection in autonomous driving, addressing temporal misalignment and feature drift in BEV representations to achieve state-of-the-art results on nuScenes.

Abstract: In autonomous driving, 3D object detection is essential for accurate perception and reliable decision-making. However, object motion and ego-motion often induce cross-frame spatiotemporal inconsistencies in BEV-based detectors, leading to temporal BEV feature misalignment and degraded spatiotemporal consistency. To address these challenges, we propose Co-Fusion4D, a unified framework that explicitly preserves cross-frame spatiotemporal consistency and suppresses temporal feature drift. Co-Fusion4D adopts a current-frame-centric strategy, treating the current frame as the primary source of information while selectively incorporating historical frames after spatiotemporal filtering and alignment. This dominant-complementary mechanism effectively mitigates cumulative alignment errors, suppresses noisy feature propagation, and exploits reliable temporal cues for a more consistent BEV representation. In addition, Co-Fusion4D integrates a Dual Attention Fusion (DAF) module to further enhance spatiotemporal feature interaction. DAF jointly leverages intra-frame spatial attention and inter-frame temporal attention to adaptively align and fuse multi-frame features, emphasizing motion-consistent regions while suppressing spurious correlations. By departing from conventional uniform fusion paradigms, this design substantially improves the temporal stability and discriminative capability of BEV representations. Extensive experiments on the nuScenes benchmark demonstrate that Co-Fusion4D achieves state-of-the-art performance, with 74.9% mAP and 75.6% NDS, without relying on test-time augmentation or external data.

摘要（中文）：在自动驾驶领域，三维目标检测对于精准感知与可靠决策至关重要。然而，物体运动与自车运动常导致基于鸟瞰图（BEV）的检测器产生跨帧时空不一致性，引发时序BEV特征错位并降低时空一致性。 为解决这些挑战，我们提出Co-Fusion4D——一个显式保持跨帧时空一致性并抑制时序特征漂移的通用框架。该框架采用以当前帧为中心的策略，将当前帧作为主要信息源，同时选择性融合经过时空滤波与对齐的历史帧。这种主辅互补机制有效缓解了累计对齐误差，抑制了噪声特征传播，并利用可靠的时序线索构建更一致的BEV表征。 此外，Co-Fusion4D集成双注意力融合（DAF）模块以增强时空特征交互。该模块联合利用帧内空间注意力与帧间时序注意力，自适应地对齐并融合多帧特征，在强调运动一致性区域的同时抑制伪相关性。通过突破传统均匀融合范式，该设计显著提升了BEV表征的时序稳定性与判别能力。 在nuScenes基准测试中的大量实验表明，Co-Fusion4D在不依赖测试时增强或外部数据的情况下，实现了74.9%平均精度（mAP）与75.6%NDS的顶尖性能。

Authors: Wenxuan Li, Qin Zou, Shoubing Chen, Chi Chen, Yingyi Yang, Shoubing Chen, Qingxiang Meng

SWEET: Sparse World Modeling with Image Editing for Embodied Task Execution WorldModel

image editing models sparse visual world models robot manipulation visual prediction task-level keyframes

简要说明：提出了SWEET，一种用于机器人操作的稀疏视觉世界模型，它利用图像编辑模型生成任务相关的关键帧，并使用扩散动作预测器进行规划。

TLDR: Proposes SWEET, a sparse visual world model for robot manipulation that uses image editing models to generate task-relevant keyframes and a diffusion action predictor for planning.

Abstract: Visual prediction has emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied control, where future observations are generated and then translated into actions. However, dense video generation is computationally expensive and often unnecessary for many manipulation tasks, whose progress can be summarized by a small number of task-relevant visual states. In this work, we study whether image editing models can serve as sparse visual world models for robot manipulation by predicting task-level future states without dense video rollout. We first conduct a controlled comparison between the video generation model Wan2.2 and the image editing model FLUX-Kontext under the same robotic data setting, and find that image editing produces more reliable task-level keyframes with better visual fidelity and substantially lower inference cost. Motivated by this observation, we propose SWEET, a one-shot sparse visual planning framework that progressively generates a sequence of task-relevant manipulation keyframes through successive image editing, conditioned on language instructions and optional arrow-based spatial guidance. A goal-conditioned diffusion action predictor then converts adjacent imagined keyframes into executable action chunks. To reduce the mismatch between real and edited visual subgoals, we further introduce a mixed-training strategy with filtered edited targets. Experiments on DROID and RoboMimic show that SWEET improves keyframe prediction across seen and unseen scenes and enables a full pipeline from sequential keyframe planning to executable robot actions, suggesting that image editing is a promising and underexplored direction for embodied visual prediction.

摘要（中文）：视觉预测已成为具身控制领域中一种前景广阔的范式，其通过生成未来观测并将其转化为行动来实现控制。然而，密集视频生成计算成本高昂，且对于许多操作任务而言往往并非必需，这类任务的进程可通过少量与任务相关的视觉状态进行概括。本文探讨了图像编辑模型能否作为机器人操作的稀疏视觉世界模型，通过预测任务层级的未来状态而无需密集视频推演。我们首先在相同机器人数据设置下，对视频生成模型Wan2.2与图像编辑模型FLUX-Kontext进行了对照比较，发现图像编辑能生成更可靠的任务层级关键帧，具有更优的视觉保真度和显著降低的推理成本。基于这一观察，我们提出SWEET框架——一种单次稀疏视觉规划方法，该框架通过连续图像编辑逐步生成与任务相关的操作关键帧序列，并以语言指令和可选的箭头式空间引导为条件。随后，目标条件扩散动作预测器将相邻的想象关键帧转换为可执行的动作块。为减少真实视觉子目标与编辑结果之间的差异，我们进一步引入基于筛选编辑目标的混合训练策略。在DROID和RoboMimic数据集上的实验表明，SWEET提升了在已知和未知场景中的关键帧预测能力，并实现了从序列关键帧规划到可执行机器人动作的完整流程，证明图像编辑是具身视觉预测中一个具有潜力且尚未被充分探索的方向。

Authors: Yiren Song, Yihan Wang, Xiyao Deng, Zhuoran Yan, Mike Zheng Shou

Probing Embodied LLMs: When Higher Observation Fidelity Hurts Problem Solving Manipulation

embodied LLM agents perceptual errors reasoning failures robotic setup closed-loop

简要说明：本文实证研究了观察保真度如何影响具身LLM的性能，发现违反直觉的是，更高保真度的输入会损害任务成功率，这是由于感知错误与推理失败之间的相互作用导致的。

TLDR: The paper empirically studies how observation fidelity affects embodied LLM performance, finding counterintuitively that higher-fidelity input can hurt task success due to interactions between perceptual errors and reasoning failures.

Abstract: Large Language Models are increasingly proposed as cognitive components for robotic systems, yet their opaque decision processes make it difficult to explain success or failure in closed-loop embodied tasks. Following an empirical AI methodology, we study embodied LLM agents behaviorally by varying the information available to the agent and measuring the resulting changes in behavior. Using the Lockbox, a sequential mechanical puzzle with hidden interdependencies, we evaluate LLMs across RGB, RGB-D, and ground-truth symbolic observations in a physical robotic setup and use controlled simulation to probe the resulting behavior. Counterintuitively, agents perform best under raw RGB input and worst under perfect ground-truth observations. In simulation, we probe this effect by randomly flipping perceived action outcomes and find that moderate noise improves performance, peaking at a 40% flip probability with a 2.85-fold success rate increase over the noise-free baseline. Further analysis links this gain to a reduction in repetitive action loops. These findings suggest that success rates alone are insufficient for evaluating LLMs, as measured performance may reflect the interaction between perceptual errors and reasoning failures rather than robust problem solving.

摘要（中文）：大型语言模型越来越多地被提议作为机器人系统的认知组件，但其不透明的决策过程使得难以解释在闭环具身任务中的成功或失败。遵循经验性人工智能方法，我们通过改变智能体可获得的信息并测量由此产生的行为变化，从行为角度研究具身语言模型智能体。利用具有隐藏依赖关系的顺序机械谜题Lockbox，我们在物理机器人设置中评估了语言模型在RGB、RGB-D和地面实况符号观察下的表现，并使用受控模拟来探究其行为。反直觉的是，智能体在原始RGB输入下表现最佳，在完美地面实况观察下表现最差。在模拟中，我们通过随机翻转感知到的动作结果来探究这一现象，发现适度噪声可提高性能，在40%翻转概率时达到峰值，成功率比无噪声基线提高2.85倍。进一步分析表明，这种增益与减少重复动作循环有关。这些发现表明，仅凭成功率不足以评估语言模型，因为测量到的性能可能反映的是感知错误与推理失败之间的相互作用，而非稳健的问题解决能力。

Authors: Oussama Zenkri, Oliver Brock

Minimalist Visual Inertial Odometry VLN

Visual-Inertial Odometry minimalist sensing photodiodes Gabor masks Temporal Convolutional Network

简要说明：本文提出一种极简的视觉惯性里程计方法，仅使用四个带有学习到Gabor掩模的向下光电二极管和一个IMU，来估计差分驱动机器人的平面运动。

TLDR: The paper presents a minimalist visual inertial odometry method using only four downward-facing photodiodes with learned Gabor masks and an IMU to estimate planar motion for differential-drive robots.

Abstract: Visual-Inertial Odometry(VIO), which is critical to mobile robot navigation, uses cameras with a large number of pixels. Capturing and processing camera images requires significant resources. This work presents a minimalist approach to planar odometry, demonstrating that just four visual measurements and an IMU can provide robust motion estimation for differential-drive robots. Our key insight is that four downward-facing photodiodes that sense the world through optical Gabor masks produce signals that encode speed. Based on this, we jointly optimize the mask parameters alongside a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) using a physically-grounded simulator. The resulting model decodes speed from just the four measurements produced by the photodiodes. Pairing these estimates with the angular speed from an IMU yields a continuous planar trajectory. We validate our approach with a prototype sensor mounted on a differential drive robot. Across diverse indoor and outdoor terrains, our system closely tracks the reference ground truth without any real-world fine-tuning. Our work shows that minimalist sensing enables efficient and accurate planar odometry.

摘要（中文）：视觉惯性里程计（VIO）是移动机器人导航的关键技术，通常依赖配备大量像素的相机。然而，采集和处理相机图像需要大量资源。本文提出了一种极简主义的平面里程计算方法，证明了仅需四个视觉测量值和一个惯性测量单元（IMU），即可为差速驱动机器人提供稳健的运动估计。我们的核心发现是：四个朝下安装并通过光学Gabor掩模感知环境的光电二极管，能够产生编码速度信息的信号。在此基础上，我们利用基于物理原理的模拟器，将掩模参数与时序卷积网络（TCN）联合优化。所得模型仅需光电二极管产生的四个测量值即可解码速度信息。将这些估计值与IMU提供的角速度结合，即可生成连续的平面轨迹。我们通过在差速驱动机器人上安装原型传感器验证了该方法。在多种室内外地形环境中，我们的系统无需任何真实世界微调，即可紧密跟踪参考真实轨迹。本研究证明，极简感知能够实现高效且准确的平面里程计算。

Authors: Francesco Pasti, Jeremy Klotz, Nicola Bellotto, Shree K. Nayar

RoHIL: Robust Human-in-the-Loop Robotic Reinforcement Learning Against Illumination Variations WorldModel

human-in-the-loop robustness illumination world-model fine-tuning

简要说明：RoHIL是一个稳健的人机协作强化学习框架，利用基于世界模型的图像重照明器和数据重放，使机器人操作策略能够适应不同工作站的光照变化，无需新的真实机器人数据。

TLDR: RoHIL is a robust human-in-the-loop RL framework that uses a world-model-based image relighter and data replay to adapt robotic manipulation policies to illumination changes across workstations without requiring new real-robot data.

Abstract: Human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning systems achieve near-perfect success on the workstation where they are trained, but collapse when the same robot is moved to a workstation a few meters away due to shifts in the visual input distribution caused by new lamp positions and window light. Re-collecting demonstrations and re-running HIL on every workstation is incompatible with deployment, and naively fine-tuning on shifted-light data triggers catastrophic forgetting of the source workstation. To close this cross-domain gap, we present RoHIL, an offline fine-tuning framework that uses no extra real-robot interaction. RoHIL combines (i) a world-model-based image relighter that re-synthesises the visual stream of source-workstation trajectories under multiple virtual HDRI environments, leaving actions and rewards real; (ii) Illumination-Retention Replay (IRR), a data-level anti-forgetting mechanism that interleaves relit adaptation transitions with original-light retention transitions to preserve source-workstation Bellman coverage; and (iii) an anchored Bellman-actor regulariser that constrains representation and policy drift from the original source-workstation policy. Across four real-robot manipulation tasks under significant cross-workstation illumination variations, RoHIL substantially improves shifted-light performance where standard HIL-RL collapses, while preserving source-workstation performance, eliminating the need to re-collect data and retrain for every new workstation and environment. Project page: https://anonymous4365.github.io/RoHIL/

摘要（中文）：摘要： 人机交互强化学习系统在训练所用工作站上能达到近乎完美的成功率，但当同一机器人被移至几米外的工作站时，由于新灯具位置和窗户光线导致的视觉输入分布变化，系统性能会急剧下降。为每个工作站重新收集演示数据并重新运行人机交互学习不符合实际部署需求，而直接在光照变化数据上进行微调又会引发对源工作站的灾难性遗忘。为弥合这一跨域差距，我们提出了RoHIL——一种无需额外真实机器人交互的离线微调框架。该框架整合了三个核心组件：（1）基于世界模型的图像光照重构器，可在多种虚拟高动态范围光照环境下重新合成源工作站轨迹的视觉流，同时保持动作与奖励的真实性；（2）光照保持回放机制，通过交织光照重构的适应轨迹与原始光照的保留轨迹，在数据层面构建抗遗忘机制，以维持源工作站的贝尔曼覆盖度；（3）锚定式贝尔曼执行器正则化器，用于约束表征与策略相对于原始源工作站策略的偏移。在四个存在显著跨工作站光照变化的真实机器人操作任务中，RoHIL大幅提升了标准人机交互强化学习失效条件下的光照变化场景性能，同时完全保持源工作站性能，消除了为每个新工作站与环境重新采集数据和训练的需求。项目页面：https://anonymous4365.github.io/RoHIL/

Authors: Shuoqin Zhang, Yixin Xiong, Xiru Gao, Kai Liu, Ke Wang, Xichuan Zhou, Zhe Hu

Beyond Action Residuals: Real-World Robot Policy Steering via Bottleneck Latent Reinforcement Learning RLRobot

latent reinforcement learning online policy adaptation robot manipulation variational information bottleneck flow-matching policies

简要说明：提出ZPRL方法，通过瓶颈隐空间而非动作残差，对预训练的机器人策略进行在线强化学习微调，在真实世界操作任务中提升了采样效率和最终性能。

TLDR: Proposes ZPRL, a method for online RL adaptation of pretrained robot policies via a bottleneck latent rather than action residuals, improving sample efficiency and final performance on real-world manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Pretrained imitation policies have become a strong foundation for robot manipulation, but they often require online improvement to overcome execution errors, limited dataset coverage, and deployment mismatch. A central question is therefore how reinforcement learning (RL) should adapt policies after offline pretraining. Existing lightweight methods commonly apply residual corrections directly in action space, but this often leads to noisy and poorly structured exploration. In this work, we propose Z-Perturbation Reinforcement Learning (ZPRL), an approach that steers pretrained policies through a compact bottleneck latent rather than through policy weights or output actions. During offline training, we augment the policy with a plug-and-play variational information bottleneck (VIB) module to extract a task-relevant latent interface from observation embeddings. During online finetuning, the base policy is frozen and RL learns only a residual perturbation on this latent, whose decoded representation conditions the frozen action generator. We instantiate ZPRL on flow-matching policies and evaluate it on eight simulation tasks and four real-world tasks. Across diverse manipulation settings, ZPRL improves both sample efficiency and final performance over strong post-training baselines. In the real world, ZPRL improves the average success rate on four tasks by 33.7% over imitation base policies while producing smoother exploration behaviors than an action residual counterpart. These results suggest that a compact, task-aligned bottleneck latent provides an effective interface for online RL adaptation. More videos can be found at https://manutdmoon.github.io/ZPRL/.

摘要（中文）：预训练模仿策略已成为机器人操作的重要基础，但这些策略通常需要在线改进以克服执行误差、数据集覆盖不足及部署不匹配等问题。因此，核心问题在于强化学习（RL）应如何在离线预训练后调整策略。现有轻量级方法通常直接在动作空间中进行残差校正，但这往往导致探索过程噪声大且结构松散。本研究提出Z-扰动强化学习（ZPRL），该方法通过紧凑的瓶颈潜变量而非策略权重或输出动作来引导预训练策略。在离线训练阶段，我们通过即插即用的变分信息瓶颈（VIB）模块增强策略，从观察嵌入中提取任务相关的潜变量接口。在线微调阶段，基础策略被冻结，强化学习仅在该潜变量上学习残差扰动，其解码后的表征作为冻结动作生成器的条件。我们将ZPRL实例化于流匹配策略，并在八个模拟任务和四个现实任务中进行评估。在多样化的操作场景中，ZPRL在样本效率和最终性能上均优于现有强后训练基线方法。在现实任务中，ZPRL将四项任务的平均成功率相较于模仿基础策略提升了33.7%，同时相比动作残差方法产生了更平滑的探索行为。这些结果表明，紧凑且任务对齐的瓶颈潜变量为在线强化学习适应提供了有效接口。更多视频可见：https://manutdmoon.github.io/ZPRL/。

Authors: Dongjie Yu, Kun Lei, Zhennan Jiang, Jia Pan, Huazhe Xu

CADENet: Condition-Adaptive Asynchronous Dual-Stream Enhancement Network for Adverse Weather Perception in Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

adverse weather perception real-time object detection condition-adaptive enhancement zero-shot weather classification training-free system

简要说明：提出了一种免训练的三线程系统，用于自动驾驶中的实时恶劣天气感知，通过条件自适应增强流和基于CLIP的天气分类，在不增加延迟的情况下提升目标检测性能。

TLDR: Proposes a training-free, three-thread system for real-time adverse weather perception in autonomous driving, using a condition-adaptive enhancement stream and CLIP-based weather classification to improve object detection without added latency.

Abstract: Adverse weather (rain, fog, sand, and snow) degrades camera-based object detection in autonomous vehicles. Existing enhancement-then-detect approaches stall the safety-critical perception loop, violating hard real-time requirements. Progress on this problem is also constrained by an under-recognized evaluation ceiling: ground truth annotated on degraded images cannot credit a detector that recovers objects the annotators themselves could not see, so a genuinely useful enhancement can register as a near-flat F1 gain. This paper presents CADENet (Condition-Adaptive Asynchronous Dual-stream Enhancement Network), a training-free three-thread system: Thread S (YOLOv11n) delivers detections at full frame rate with zero added latency; Thread Q applies condition-adaptive enhancement (CAPE) and fuses results via entropy-guided NMS (EG-NMS) without blocking Thread S; Thread E provides CLIP zero-shot weather classification, so new weather categories require only a new text prompt, with no labeled data and no retraining. Evaluated on 1327 DAWN images (YOLOv11m, IoU = 0.5, confidence = 0.25), CADENet achieves Recall = 0.0103 (micro), F1 = 0.0230 on snow, and F1 = 0.0038 on rain. We formalize the annotation completeness bias on DAWN-class data, so the reported F1 values are lower bounds on the true gain; recall is the annotation-gap-immune headline metric. Thread S sustains approximately 44 FPS regardless of enhancement load. No model retraining or additional sensor hardware is required.

摘要（中文）：摘要：恶劣天气（雨、雾、沙尘与雪）会降低基于摄像头的自动驾驶目标检测性能。现有的"先增强后检测"方法会阻塞安全关键感知回路，难以满足严格的实时性要求。该问题的研究进展还受到一个未被充分认识的评估上限制约：在退化图像上标注的真实标签无法反映检测器恢复人眼不可见物体的能力，因此真正有效的增强方法在F1分数上可能仅呈现近乎平坦的提升。本文提出CADENet（条件自适应异步双流增强网络），这是一种免训练的三线程系统：线程S（YOLOv11n）以全帧率执行检测且零延迟增加；线程Q通过条件自适应增强模块（CAPE）进行处理，并经由熵引导非极大值抑制（EG-NMS）融合结果，全程不阻塞线程S；线程E提供CLIP零样本天气分类，新增天气类别仅需文本提示而无需标注数据与重新训练。在1327张DAWN数据集图像上评估（YOLOv11m，IoU=0.5，置信度=0.25），CADENet在雪天场景召回率达0.0103（微观），F1分数为0.0230；雨天F1分数为0.0038。我们形式化分析了DAWN类数据的标注完整性偏差，故所报F1值为真实增益的下界；召回率成为不受标注偏差影响的核心指标。无论增强负载如何变化，线程S始终保持约44帧/秒的速率。本方法无需模型重训练或额外传感器硬件。

Authors: Sherif Khairy, Catherine M. Elias

D-CLING: Prior-Preserving Depth-Conditioned Fine-Tuning for Navigation Foundation Models VLN

navigation foundation models fine-tuning ControlNet zero-initialized residual pathways continual learning

简要说明：提出D-CLING，一种用于导航基础模型的深度条件微调方法，通过零初始化残差路径保留预训练先验，实现鲁棒的长距离导航。

TLDR: Proposes D-CLING, a depth-conditioned fine-tuning method for Navigation Foundation Models that preserves pre-trained priors via zero-initialized residual pathways, enabling robust long-horizon navigation.

Abstract: Navigation Foundation Models (NFMs) trained on large cross-embodied datasets have demonstrated powerful generalizability in various scenarios. Adopting in-domain fine-tuning for an NFM efficiently calibrates the visuomotor policy, promising further improvement even in a novel scenario. However, the fine-tuned models still suffer from poor obstacle avoidance or fail to properly reach the provided goals. Furthermore, model updates using a small subset of data typically erode the pre-trained prior, compromising the pre-training generalization. Consequently, fine-tuning deteriorates the capability of the model for robust and accurate navigation. In this work, we present a novel fine-tuning method that leverages large-scale pre-training while efficiently learning in novel setups, such as environments or camera configurations. In particular, inspired by ControlNet, we fine-tune an NFM by attaching a trainable copy of the pre-trained backbone using zero-initialized residual pathways, thereby learning geometric cues. This design enables the model to efficiently acquire in-domain geometry while preserving pre-trained knowledge across various behaviors. Despite its simplicity, our comprehensive evaluation of real-world navigation suggests that our proposal effectively enables robust long-horizon navigation with minimal collisions and human intervention. Additionally, our offline analysis shows that the proposed method maintains or further improves action prediction capabilities beyond the fine-tuned dataset, providing a key insight into continual learning for general navigation. The project page: https://toyotafrc.github.io/DCLING-Proj/

摘要（中文）：在大规模跨实体数据集上训练的导航基础模型（NFMs）已在多种场景中展现出强大的泛化能力。通过对NFM进行领域内微调，能够有效校准视觉运动策略，即使在全新场景中也具有进一步提升的潜力。然而，经微调的模型仍存在避障能力不足或无法准确抵达指定目标的问题。此外，使用小规模数据子集进行模型更新通常会削弱预训练的先验知识，从而损害预训练的泛化性能。因此，微调反而会降低模型实现鲁棒且精准导航的能力。 本文提出了一种新颖的微调方法，该方法在高效学习新设置（如环境或相机配置）的同时，能够充分利用大规模预训练的优势。具体而言，受ControlNet启发，我们通过附加预训练主干的可训练副本，并采用零初始化残差路径对NFM进行微调，从而学习几何线索。该设计使模型在有效获取领域内几何信息的同时，保留预训练模型在各种行为中习得的知识。尽管方法简洁，我们在真实世界导航中的综合评估表明，所提方案能够以极低的碰撞率和人工干预实现鲁棒的长距离导航。此外，离线分析显示该方法在微调数据集之外保持甚至进一步提升了动作预测能力，这为通用导航的持续学习提供了关键见解。项目页面：https://toyotafrc.github.io/DCLING-Proj/

Authors: Shintaro Nakaoka, Takayuki Kanai, Kazuhito Tanaka

CANINE: Coaching Visually Impaired Users for Interactive Navigation with a Robot Guide Dog VLN

interactive navigation robot guide dog coaching system foundation models verbal feedback

简要说明：该论文提出了CANINE，一个利用基础模型提供自适应语言反馈的自动化训练系统，用于训练视障用户与机器人导盲犬进行交互式导航。

TLDR: The paper presents CANINE, an automated coaching system that uses foundation models to provide adaptive verbal feedback, training visually impaired users for interactive navigation with a robot guide dog.

Abstract: Robot guide dogs offer navigation assistance that greatly expands the independent mobility of the visually impaired, but their effective use requires subtle human-robot coordination that is difficult for users to learn from generic verbal instructions. To tackle this challenge, we present CANINE, an automated coaching system that trains users for interactive navigation with a robot guide dog, through personalized, adaptive verbal feedback. CANINE decomposes a complex coordination task into sub-skills and operates at two levels. At the high level, it decides what to train by tracking the learner's proficiency across sub-skills using knowledge tracing and prioritizing training on the weakest areas. At the low level, CANINE decides how to train each sub-skill by observing each human practice episode, using foundation models to infer the underlying causes of errors, and generating targeted verbal corrections adaptively. A controlled study with blindfolded participants, treated as a proxy population for quantitative evaluation, demonstrates that CANINE significantly improves both learning efficiency and final navigation performance compared to generic verbal instructions. We further validate CANINE through a retention study and an exploratory case study. The retention study shows lasting skill improvement after two weeks. The case study confirms CANINE's effectiveness in training a visually impaired user, while revealing additional design considerations for real-world deployment. Both are well aligned with the findings of the controlled study. Project page: https://cunjunyu.github.io/project/canine/

摘要（中文）：导盲机器人为视障人士提供导航辅助，大幅扩展了其独立行动能力，但有效使用需要微妙的人机协同，用户难以通过通用口头指令掌握相关技能。为应对这一挑战，我们提出CANINE——一种通过个性化自适应语音反馈训练用户与导盲机器人进行交互导航的自动教练系统。CANINE将复杂的协同任务分解为子技能，并在两个层面运行：高层通过知识追踪监测学习者对各子技能的掌握程度，优先针对薄弱环节进行训练；底层则通过观察每次人工练习片段，利用基础模型推断操作失误的根本原因，并自适应生成针对性语音纠正。通过对蒙眼参与者（作为定量评估的代理人群）开展对照实验，证明相比通用口头指令，CANINE能显著提升学习效率和最终导航表现。我们通过保持性研究及探索性案例研究进一步验证了该系统：保持性研究表明两周后技能提升效果持续存在；案例研究不仅证实了CANINE在训练视障用户方面的有效性，还揭示了实际部署中需考量的额外设计因素。两项研究均与对照实验结论高度吻合。项目页面：https://cunjunyu.github.io/project/canine/

Authors: Cunjun Yu, Zishuo Wang, Anxing Xiao, Linfeng Li, David Hsu

Sampling-Based Safe Reinforcement Learning RLRobot

safe reinforcement learning model-based RL safe exploration continuous control robotic hardware

简要说明：提出一种基于采样的安全强化学习算法，通过约束一组动态样本，在连续机器人领域中实现安全探索和理论保证。

TLDR: A model-based RL algorithm with safety guarantees during learning by constraining across dynamics samples, enabling safe exploration in continuous robotic domains.

Abstract: Safe exploration remains a fundamental challenge in reinforcement learning (RL), limiting the deployment of RL agents in the real world. We propose Sampling-Based Safe Reinforcement Learning (SBSRL), a model-based RL algorithm that maintains safety throughout the learning process by enforcing constraints jointly across a finite set of dynamics samples. This formulation approximates an intractable worst-case optimization over uncertain dynamics and enables practical safety guarantees in continuous domains. We further introduce an exploration strategy based on constraining epistemic uncertainty, eliminating the need for explicit exploration bonuses. Under regularity conditions, we derive high-probability guarantees of safety throughout learning and a finite-time sample complexity bound for recovering a near-optimal policy. Empirically, SBSRL achieves safe and efficient exploration both in simulation and in real robotic hardware, and readily extends to practical deep-ensemble implementations that scale to high-dimensional continuous control problems.

摘要（中文）：安全探索仍然是强化学习中的一个根本性挑战，制约着强化学习智能体在现实世界的部署。本文提出基于采样的安全强化学习方法，这是一种基于模型的强化学习算法，通过在一组有限动态样本上联合实施约束，从而在整个学习过程中维持安全性。该方法可近似处理不确定动态条件下难以求解的最坏情况优化问题，并为连续域问题提供实用的安全保证。我们进一步提出一种基于认知不确定性约束的探索策略，无需显式探索奖励机制。在满足正则性条件下，我们推导出学习过程中安全性的高概率保证，以及恢复接近最优策略的有限时间样本复杂度界限。实验表明，基于采样的安全强化学习方法在仿真和真实机器人硬件平台上均实现了安全高效的探索，并可扩展至适用于高维连续控制问题的深度集成实施方案。

Authors: Luca Vignola, Bruce D. Lee, Manish Prajapat, Manuel Wendl, Melanie Zeilinger, Andreas Krause, Yarden As

Neuromorphic Control of a Flapping-Wing Robot on Resource-Constrained Hardware Locomotion

Spiking Neural Networks Flapping-Wing Robot Onboard Control Resource-Constrained Hardware Imitation Learning

简要说明：提出了一种基于脉冲神经网络的层次化神经形态控制框架，用于扑翼微型飞行器的完全机载闭环飞行，在资源受限的微控制器上降低了延迟和功耗。

TLDR: Presents a hierarchical neuromorphic control framework using Spiking Neural Networks for fully onboard, closed-loop flight of a flapping-wing micro aerial vehicle, reducing latency and power on a resource-constrained microcontroller.

Abstract: Flapping-Wing Micro Aerial Vehicles (FWMAVs) provide exceptional maneuverability and aerodynamic efficiency but pose significant challenges for onboard control due to nonlinear dynamics and stringent Size, Weight, and Power (SWaP) constraints, as exemplified by a butterfly-inspired robot less than 30 gram. To this end, we present a hierarchical neuromorphic control framework that enables fully onboard, closed-loop flight on a widely available, resource-constrained ESP32 microcontroller with a unit cost of approximately $5. Specifically, our method deploys two lightweight Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) onboard: one for state estimation from raw sensory feedback and another for control via modulation of a Central Pattern Generator (CPG) for wing actuation. Trained by imitation learning, the system achieves stable pitch and heading angle tracking during untethered real-world flight. Experimental results further reveal that the SNN-based controller reduces latency by 36% (1059us to 680us) and power by 18% (0.033W to 0.027W) for inference compared to the conventional Artificial Neural Network (ANN) baseline, demonstrating the viability of spike-based computation without specialized hardware. To the best of our knowledge, this work constitutes the first demonstration of fully onboard neuromorphic control for autonomous flight of a FWMAV, highlighting the potential of SNNs to enable energy-efficient autonomy under stringent SWaP constraints. Visual abstract: http://bit.ly/4nI8ECY

摘要（中文）：扑翼微型飞行器（FWMAV）具备卓越的机动性与气动效率，但其非线性动力学特性以及严格的尺寸、重量与功率（SWaP）约束（例如质量低于30克的仿蝴蝶机器人）给机载控制带来了巨大挑战。为此，本文提出一种分层神经形态控制框架，能够在成本仅约5美元、资源受限的通用ESP32微控制器上实现全机载闭环飞行。具体而言，本方法在机载部署两个轻量级脉冲神经网络（SNN）：一个用于从原始传感器反馈中估计状态，另一个通过调制中央模式发生器（CPG）控制翅膀驱动机构。通过模仿学习训练后，该系统在无缆真实飞行中实现了稳定的俯仰角与偏航角跟踪。实验结果表明，相比传统人工神经网络（ANN）基线，基于SNN的控制器推理延迟降低36%（从1059微秒降至680微秒），功耗降低18%（从0.033瓦降至0.027瓦），这验证了无需专用硬件的脉冲计算方案的可行性。据我们所知，本研究首次实现了FWMAV全机载神经形态控制的自主飞行，凸显了SNN在严格SWaP约束下实现高效能自主控制的潜力。视觉摘要：http://bit.ly/4nI8ECY

Authors: Rim El Filali, Chenrui Feng, Chao Gao, Weibin Gu

Beyond Waypoints: Dual-Heatmap Grounding for Cross-Embodiment Semantic Navigation VLN

semantic navigation vision-language framework dual-heatmap cross-embodiment affordance prediction

简要说明：提出一种视觉语言框架，用于语义导航，使用双热图预测替代确定性路径点，通过连续的可行走区域和朝向热图，提升跨机器人平台的可执行性和可靠性。

TLDR: Proposes a vision-language framework using dual-heatmap predictions for semantic navigation, replacing deterministic waypoints with continuous affordance and facing heatmaps for better cross-embodiment transfer and execution reliability.

Abstract: Grounding open-ended semantic instructions into physically executable local goals is a fundamental challenge in human-robot interaction. While existing navigation frameworks often regress deterministic waypoints, this rigid formulation collapses spatial uncertainty and frequently targets non-traversable object centers, leading to severe execution failures. In this work, we focus on the practical setting of in-FOV semantic navigation, where a robot receives concise, interleaved multimodal (text and image) prompts. To bridge the gap between abstract semantic intent and physical reachability, we propose a unified Vision-Language framework that abandons single-point regression in favor of a Dual-Heatmap representation. Our framework predicts a navigation affordance heatmap that captures continuous reachable regions, coupled with a facing heatmap for orientation constraints. These dense outputs inherently function as a differentiable semantic potential field, integrating seamlessly with downstream local planners. To support this paradigm, we build a fully automated, foundation-model-assisted synthetic data pipeline and establish a comprehensive simulation benchmark. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance among comparable 8B baselines. Crucially, a feature-fusion study and simulation studies across diverse robot embodiments (Jetbot, H1, Aliengo) reveal that explicit heatmap prediction drastically improves the Affordance Rate (AR). By placing targets reliably in executable free space, our framework effectively mitigates the brittleness of point regression, offering a transferable path toward safe cross-embodiment semantic navigation.

摘要（中文）：将开放式的语义指令具体化为物理上可执行的局部目标是人机交互领域的一项基础性挑战。现有的导航框架通常采用确定性路径点回归方法，但这种刚性表达方式忽略了空间不确定性，并且常常将目标定位于不可通行的物体中心，导致严重的执行失败。本研究聚焦于视场内语义导航这一实际场景，其中机器人接收简洁的多模态（文本与图像）交错指令。为了弥合抽象语义意图与物理可达性之间的鸿沟，我们提出了一种统一的视觉-语言框架，摒弃单点回归方法，转而采用双热图表示。该框架预测一个导航可供性热图以捕捉连续可达区域，同时配合一个面向热图用于方向约束。这些密集输出本质上构成了一个可微分的语义势场，能够与下游局部规划器无缝集成。为支持这一范式，我们构建了一个全自动的、基于基础模型的合成数据流水线，并建立了一个全面的仿真基准。大量实验表明，我们的框架在同类80亿参数基线中达到了最先进的性能水平。关键的是，特征融合研究及跨多种机器人实体（Jetbot、H1、Aliengo）的仿真研究表明：显式的热图预测能显著提升可供性成功率。通过将目标可靠地定位在可执行自由空间内，我们的框架有效缓解了单点回归的脆弱性，为安全跨实体语义导航提供了可迁移的实现路径。

Authors: Kaijie Yun, Yue Chen

RoboJailBench: Benchmarking Adversarial Attacks and Defenses in Embodied Robotic Agents VLA

adversarial attacks embodied AI Vision-Language Models jailbreak security evaluation

简要说明：提出RoboJailBench，一个用于评估集成视觉语言模型的具身AI系统中对抗性越狱攻击与防御的标准化基准。

TLDR: Introduces RoboJailBench, a standardized benchmark for evaluating adversarial jailbreak attacks and defenses in embodied AI systems that integrate Vision-Language Models.

Abstract: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) facilitate a new class of embodied AI systems, where these models are integrated into physical platforms, e.g. robots and autonomous vehicles, to interpret visual scenes and execute natural language commands in diverse environments. Previous research has introduced jailbreak attacks and defenses for embodied AI. Their evaluations, however, rely on ad-hoc datasets, limited metrics, and emphasize attack success while neglecting the trade-off between security and the ability to follow benign commands. Existing benchmarks and evaluation frameworks either target traditional chat-based models or focus on non-adversarial safety evaluation for embodied AI; neither captures the adversarial risks, inputs, consequences, and evaluation criteria necessary for jailbreak attacks in embodied AI systems. In this paper, we address this gap with RoboJailBench, which consists of three core components. We establish a security taxonomy derived from ISO standards, regulatory rules, and documented incidents. This effort yields 18 categories of security violation consequences for embodied AI. We introduce an intent contrast dataset pipeline that augments existing datasets with paired adversarial and benign goals to measure both security and utility. Lastly, we provide an evolving repository with standardized metrics and a unified process for assessing and integrating new attacks and defenses. With this benchmark, we construct a new taxonomy-balanced dataset and augment five existing datasets. We integrate four attacks and two defenses to evaluate their performance on leading embodied VLMs. This benchmark provides the first standardized evaluation framework for jailbreak attacks in embodied AI and supports future research. We release our code, datasets, and artifacts, and maintain a leaderboard at https://purseclab.github.io/benchmark-for-robotics-security.

摘要（中文）：近期，视觉-语言模型的进展催生了一类新型具身智能系统，这些模型被集成到机器人、自动驾驶车辆等物理平台中，用于解析视觉场景并在多样环境中执行自然语言指令。先前的研究已针对具身AI提出了越狱攻击与防御方法，但其评估依赖于特定数据集和有限的评价指标，且过于侧重攻击成功率，忽视了安全性与执行正常指令能力之间的权衡。现有的基准测试与评估框架要么针对传统聊天模型，要么聚焦于具身AI的非对抗性安全评估，均未充分涵盖具身AI系统越狱攻击所需的对抗风险、输入类型、后果影响及评估标准。本文通过构建RoboJailBench填补了这一空白，该基准包含三个核心组件。我们依据ISO标准、监管规则及已记录的安全事件建立了一套安全分类体系，归纳出18类具身AI安全违规后果。我们提出了一种意图对比数据管道，通过在现有数据集中配对对抗性目标与良性目标，实现对安全性与实用性的双重度量。最后，我们创建了一个持续更新的标准化指标库和统一流程，用于评估和集成新的攻击与防御方法。基于该基准，我们构建了新型分类平衡数据集，并对五个现有数据集进行了增强。我们整合了四种攻击方法与两种防御机制，对主流具身视觉-语言模型进行了性能评估。该基准为首个面向具身AI越狱攻击的标准化评估框架，将为未来研究提供支持。我们已公开代码、数据集及相关资源，并持续维护排行榜于https://purseclab.github.io/benchmark-for-robotics-security。

Authors: Doguhuan Yeke, Yanming Zhou, Leo Y. Lin, Hongyu Cai, Antonio Bianchi, Z. Berkay Celik

ContextFlow: Hierarchical Task-State Alignment for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents VLN

task-state misalignment hierarchical alignment embodied agents long-horizon tasks inspectable framework

简要说明：本文提出ContextFlow，一个用于长视野具身智能体中层次化任务-状态对齐的可检查框架，通过明确的契约、证据包和范围更新来解决任务状态错位等故障。

TLDR: The paper proposes ContextFlow, an inspectable framework for hierarchical task-state alignment in long-horizon embodied agents, addressing failures like task-state misalignment through explicit contracts, evidence packets, and scoped updates.

Abstract: Long-horizon embodied agents increasingly delegate navigation, search, approach, and manipulation to specialist executors. As these executors become stronger, the main bottleneck shifts from local skill execution to maintaining a coherent task frontier across planning, monitoring, memory, and execution. We study task-state misalignment, a task-level consistency failure in which the planner's active stage, runtime evidence, remembered context, and delegated executor no longer justify the same next-step decision. This failure can lead to unsupported handoffs, stage lock, executor-context mismatch, and unnecessary replanning. We propose ContextFlow, an inspectable alignment framework that represents stages as explicit contracts, converts runtime observations into evidence packets, and applies scoped updates including continue, refine, transfer, promote, and repair. ContextFlow keeps specialist executors responsible for local closed-loop control while making task-frontier alignment explicit and auditable. Experiments and demonstration traces on long-horizon embodied tasks illustrate how evidence-grounded scoped updates diagnose and mitigate recurring task-state failures.

摘要（中文）：长期规划的具身智能体逐渐将导航、搜索、接近和操作等任务委托给专业化执行器。随着这些执行器能力不断增强，主要瓶颈已从局部技能执行转向规划、监控、记忆与执行间的任务前沿协同维护。本研究聚焦任务状态失准问题——即规划器当前阶段、运行时证据、记忆上下文与委托执行器之间无法共同支撑下一步决策的任务级一致性失效。此类失效可能引发无依据的任务移交、阶段锁死、执行器-上下文错配以及非必要重规划。我们提出ContextFlow框架：通过将任务阶段表示为显式契约、将运行时观测转化为证据包，并应用包括延续、细化、转移、升级与修复在内的限定范围更新，实现可审查的协同机制。该框架在保持专业化执行器负责局部闭环控制的同时，使任务前沿协同过程变得显式化且可审计。在长程具身任务上的实验与演示轨迹表明，基于证据的限定范围更新能有效诊断并缓解反复出现的任务状态失效问题。

Authors: Shuhan Guo, Kun Zhang, Haifei Liu, Xingyu Gao, Yongqi Zhang, Yaqing Wang, Quanming Yao

Domain-Adaptive Communication-Rate Optimization for Sim-to-Real Humanoid-Robot Wireless XR Teleoperation HumanoidEmbodied

wireless XR teleoperation communication-rate optimization sim-to-real humanoid robot proximal policy optimization (PPO)

简要说明：本文为仿人机器人无线XR遥操作开发了一种模拟到现实的通信速率优化系统，使用带密度比加权的PPO来改善运动重建误差与通信能耗之间的权衡。

TLDR: The paper develops a sim-to-real communication-rate optimization system for wireless XR teleoperation of humanoid robots, using PPO with density-ratio weighting to improve the tradeoff between motion reconstruction error and communication energy.

Abstract: Wireless extended reality (XR) teleoperation provides embodied interaction capability for collecting humanoid robot demonstrations, but the large-scale adoption is restricted by the overhead of high-frequency motion transmission. This paper develops a system framework that integrates sampling, transmission, interpolation, and reconstruction and formulates a communication-rate optimization that aims to minimize the communication energy while maintaining the reconstruction accuracy of robot motion trajectories through dimension-wise sampling-rate control. Since acquiring real-time feedback from physical robots is limited by hardware costs, it is necessary to solve the problem through simulator interaction with offline real-domain data correction. To guide sim-to-real adaptation, we provide a PAC-Bayes generalization characterization that reveals the effects of latent density-ratio estimation, finite-sample deviation, and encoder bias. Building on this analysis, we propose a proximal policy optimization (PPO) method with density-ratio weighting and trust-region regularization. Experiments on public humanoid teleoperation dataset show that the proposed method improves the tradeoff between reconstruction error and communication energy consumption under sim-to-real distribution shift. We further analyze the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm across various wireless channels and dynamic motion trajectories.

摘要（中文）：无线扩展现实（XR）遥操作为人形机器人演示数据的采集提供了具身交互能力，但其大规模应用受限于高频运动数据传输的开销。本文开发了一个集采样、传输、插值与重构于一体的系统框架，并通过基于维度的采样率控制，构建了一种通信速率优化方法，旨在最小化通信能耗的同时保持机器人运动轨迹的重建精度。由于从物理机器人获取实时反馈受硬件成本限制，需借助模拟器交互并结合离线真实域数据校正来解决该问题。为引导模拟到真实的适配，我们提出了一种PAC-Bayes泛化表征，揭示了潜在密度比估计、有限样本偏差与编码器偏置的影响机制。基于此分析，本文提出一种结合密度比加权与信任域正则化的近端策略优化（PPO）方法。在公开人形遥操作数据集上的实验表明，该方法在模拟到真实的分布偏移下改善了重建误差与通信能耗之间的权衡关系。我们进一步分析了所提算法在不同无线信道及动态运动轨迹下的有效性。

Authors: Caolu Xu, Zhiyong Chen, Meixia Tao, Li Song, Feng Yang, Wenjun Zhang

Aerial Inspection Behaviors via RL-based Quadrotor Control for Under-canopy Forest Environments RLRobot

Reinforcement Learning Quadrotor Control Aerial Inspection RRT* TSP

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于深度强化学习的低层四旋翼控制器，结合使用TSP和RRT*的导航引导层，用于林冠下森林环境中安全、长距离的空中巡检任务。

TLDR: This paper presents a deep RL-based low-level quadrotor controller for aerial inspection, combined with a navigation guidance layer using TSP and RRT* for safe, long-range missions in under-canopy forest environments.

Abstract: This paper addresses the problem of using a deep Reinforcement Learning (RL)-based low-level Quadrotor controller within an autonomous Quadrotor navigation stack for aerial inspection missions in under-canopy forest environments. Specifically, the article presents an end-to-end (mapping states to RPMs) Quadrotor control policy that achieves inspection view-pose tracking (simultaneous position and yaw reference tracking), which is crucial for various target inspection behaviors and point-to-point navigation in forests. To ensure safe and reliable deployment of the end-to-end RL controller in long-range missions, this article utilizes a higher navigation guidance layer comprising of a Traveling Salesman Problem planner (TSP) and a Rapidly-exploring Random Tree Star (RRT*) planner. Over a known map of a forest and a set of user-specified inspection regions, the TSP planner finds the optimal visitation sequence. Between two target regions, collision-free paths that respect the tracking limitations of the lower end-to-end RL policy are generated by an RRT* planner. Through five target inspection scenarios, this article demonstrates that an RL-based motor-level stabilizing controller, supported by a navigation guidance layer, can be used effectively as the low-level inspection execution module for under-canopy forest inspection missions.

摘要（中文）：本文探讨了在树冠下森林环境空中巡检任务中，将基于深度强化学习（RL）的低层四旋翼控制器应用于自主四旋翼导航系统的问题。文章具体提出了一种端到端（从状态映射至电机转速）的四旋翼控制策略，该策略能够实现巡检视角位姿跟踪（位置与偏航角参考的同步跟踪），这对于森林环境中多种目标巡检行为及点对点导航至关重要。为确保端到端强化学习控制器在长距离任务中的安全可靠部署，本文构建了包含旅行商问题规划器（TSP）与快速探索随机树星型算法（RRT*）的高层导航引导层。基于已知森林地图和用户指定的巡检区域集合，TSP规划器可生成最优访问序列；而在两个目标区域之间，RRT*规划器能够生成符合底层端到端强化学习策略跟踪限制的无碰撞路径。通过五种目标巡检场景的验证，本文证明了基于强化学习的电机级稳定控制器在导航引导层的支持下，能够有效作为树冠下森林巡检任务的低层巡检执行模块。

Authors: Fausto Mauricio Lagos Suarez, Akshit Saradagi, Vidya Sumathy, Viswa Narayanan Sankaranarayanan, George Nikolakopoulos

A Heuristic Approach for Performance Tuning in RL-based Quadrotor Control via Reward Design and Termination Conditions RLRobot

reinforcement learning quadrotor control reward design performance tuning setpoint tracking

简要说明：本文提出了一种启发式方法，通过奖励设计和终止条件来调整基于强化学习的四旋翼控制性能，实现可调的性能以应对不同任务需求。

TLDR: The paper introduces a heuristic method for tuning RL-based quadrotor control performance using reward design and episode truncation, enabling adjustable settling times for tasks like inspection or acrobatics.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL)-based quadrotor control policies have achieved impressive performance in tasks such as fast navigation in cluttered environments and drone racing, where the focus is on speed and agility. However, in several applications, such as infrastructure inspection, it is critical to achieve precise, controlled maneuvers with tunable performance. In this article, we present a novel heuristic approach to achieve tunable performance in RL-based Quadrotor control through reward design and termination conditions. We present a novel reward structure containing dual bandwidth exponentials that achieves a baseline critically damped response in setpoint tracking, with low steady-state errors. When trained with a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm, in conjunction with episode truncation conditions, the desired performance is achieved in 6 million time steps in a sample-efficient manner. In order to tune the performance about the baseline behavior, we present intuitive heuristic rules to adjust the reward weights and exponential coefficients to achieve faster (acrobatic-like) and slower (inspection-like) settling time performance, while retaining the baseline critically damped response and approximately 2\% steady-state error. We evaluate the three RL policies (baseline, acrobatic, and inspection) across 100 trials and show accurate and tunable performance in position and yaw tracking from random initial conditions, thereby demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed heuristic approach.

摘要（中文）：基于强化学习的四旋翼无人机控制策略在杂乱环境中的快速导航和无人机竞速等任务中取得了令人瞩目的性能，这些任务侧重于速度和敏捷性。然而，在基础设施巡检等多种应用中，实现具有可调性能的精确、受控机动至关重要。本文提出了一种新颖的启发式方法，通过奖励设计和终止条件，在基于强化学习的四旋翼控制中实现性能可调。我们提出了一种包含双带宽指数项的新型奖励结构，该结构能够在设定点跟踪中实现具有低稳态误差的临界阻尼响应基准。当与近端策略优化算法结合训练，并配合回合截断条件时，可在600万时间步内以样本高效的方式实现预期性能。为了在基准行为基础上调整性能，我们提出直观的启发式规则来调整奖励权重和指数系数，以实现更快（类特技飞行）和更慢（类巡检）的稳定时间性能，同时保持基准的临界阻尼响应和约2%的稳态误差。我们对三种强化学习策略（基准、特技和巡检）进行了100次试验评估，结果表明在随机初始条件下位置和偏航跟踪均具有精确且可调的性能，从而验证了所提出启发式方法的有效性。
