Authors: Fausto Mauricio Lagos Suarez, Akshit Saradagi, Vidya Sumathy, George Nikolakopoulos

COBALT: Crowdsourcing Robot Learning via Cloud-Based Teleoperation with Smartphones Manipulation

teleoperation crowdsourcing imitation learning robot learning demonstration data

简要说明：COBALT是一个基于云端的可扩展遥操作平台，使用智能手机等设备众包高质量机器人演示数据，为机器人模仿学习实现高效的大规模数据收集。

TLDR: COBALT is a scalable cloud-based teleoperation platform for crowdsourcing high-quality robot demonstration data using smartphones and other devices, enabling efficient large-scale imitation learning for robotic manipulation.

Abstract: The scarcity of large-scale, high-quality demonstration data remains a bottleneck in scaling imitation learning for robotic manipulation. We present COBALT, a teleoperation platform designed to democratize robot learning at scale both in simulation and in the real world. By leveraging vectorized environments, our scalable, load-balanced infrastructure supports concurrent teleoperation by multiple users on a single GPU, yielding a significant reduction in teleoperation cost. Operators can connect from nearly anywhere on Earth using commonly available devices, including single or dual smartphones, VR headsets, 3D mice, and keyboards. An inmemory data cache and efficient video streaming keep control and rendering synchronous, sustaining dozens of concurrent users at 20 Hz with sub-100 ms end-to-end latency for up to 8 concurrent users per GPU. We also demonstrate stable operation supporting 256 simulated clients across 8 GPUs, underscoring the system's ability to scale across hardware and within individual servers. We perform a comprehensive user study showing that phone-based teleoperation performs comparably to or better than specialized hardware, enabling faster, more ergonomic data collection. To ensure data quality, COBALT logs a suite of real-time metrics to automatically filter suboptimal demonstrations. We further demonstrate that a structured user training curriculum significantly improves data collection quality. Guided by insights from our user study, we crowdsource the collection of a large-scale, high-quality pilot dataset with 7500+ demonstrations (50+ hours) collected with smartphones across nine countries over five days. We validate the dataset's quality by training state-of-the-art imitation learning algorithms. Please visit https://cobalt-teleop.github.io/ for more details.

摘要（中文）：大规模高质量示范数据的稀缺性，仍是制约机器人操作模仿学习规模化发展的瓶颈。我们提出COBALT——一个旨在推动仿真与真实世界中规模化机器人学习普及的遥操作平台。通过利用向量化环境，我们可扩展、负载均衡的基础设施支持多用户在单GPU上并发遥操作，显著降低了遥操作成本。操作者可使用常见设备（包括单/双智能手机、VR头显、3D鼠标和键盘）几乎从全球任何地方接入平台。内存数据缓存与高效视频流传输技术实现了控制与渲染同步，在单GPU支持最多8名并发用户时，能够维持20Hz刷新率且端到端延迟低于100毫秒，同时支持数十名并发用户稳定运行。我们还演示了跨8个GPU支持256个仿真客户端的稳定运行，凸显了系统在跨硬件及单服务器内部的扩展能力。通过全面的用户研究表明，基于手机的遥操作性能与专用硬件相当甚至更优，可实现更快速、更符合人体工程学的数据采集。为确保数据质量，COBALT实时记录多项指标以自动筛选次优示范数据。我们进一步证明，结构化的用户培训课程能显著提升数据采集质量。基于用户研究的洞察，我们在五天内通过众包方式收集了来自九个国家、使用智能手机采集的大规模高质量试点数据集，包含7500余次演示（50多小时）。通过训练前沿模仿学习算法，我们验证了该数据集的质量。更多详情请访问 https://cobalt-teleop.github.io/。

Authors: Ayush Agarwal, Ansh Gandhi, Jeremy A. Collins, Omar Rayyan, Aryan Sarswat, Ranjani Koushik, Masoud Moghani, Ajay Mandlekar, Animesh Garg

RLFTSim: Realistic and Controllable Multi-Agent Traffic Simulation via Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning AutonomousDriving

traffic simulation reinforcement learning multi-agent goal-conditioned realism

简要说明：一个通过强化学习微调的框架，可提升多智能体交通仿真的真实性与可控性，通过仿真过程与真实世界数据分布对齐，并实现目标条件化的场景生成。

TLDR: A reinforcement learning fine-tuning framework that improves the realism and controllability of multi-agent traffic simulation by aligning with real data distributions and enabling goal-conditioned scenario generation.

Abstract: Supervised open-loop training has been widely adopted for training traffic simulation models; however, it fails to capture the inherently dynamic, multi-agent interactions common in complex driving scenarios. We introduce RLFTSim, a reinforcement-learning-based fine-tuning framework that enhances scenario realism by aligning simulator rollouts with real-world data distributions and provides a method for distilling goal-conditioned controllability in scenario generation. We instantiate RLFTSim on top of a pre-trained simulation model, design a reward that balances fidelity and controllability, and perform comprehensive experiments on the Waymo Open Motion Dataset. Our results show improvements in realism, achieving state-of-the-art performance. Compared with other heuristic search-based fine-tuning methods, RLFTSim requires significantly fewer samples due to a proposed low-variance and dense reward signal, and it directly addresses the realism alignment issue by design. We also demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach for distilling traffic simulation controllability through goal conditioning. The project page is available at https://ehsan-ami.github.io/rlftsim.

摘要（中文）：监督式开环训练在交通仿真模型训练中已被广泛采用；然而，该方法难以捕捉复杂驾驶场景中固有的动态多智能体交互特性。我们提出了RLFTSim——一种基于强化学习的微调框架，通过将仿真器推演结果与现实世界数据分布对齐来提升场景真实性，同时提供了一种在场景生成中提取目标条件可控性的方法。我们在预训练的仿真模型基础上实例化了RLFTSim，设计了平衡真实性与可控性的奖励函数，并在Waymo开放运动数据集上进行了全面实验。结果表明，我们的方法在真实性方面实现了显著提升，达到了当前最优性能。与其他基于启发式搜索的微调方法相比，RLFTSim提出的低方差密集奖励信号使其所需样本量显著减少，并通过架构设计直接解决了真实性对齐问题。我们还通过目标条件控制验证了本方法在提取交通仿真可控性方面的有效性。项目页面详见：https://ehsan-ami.github.io/rlftsim。

Authors: Ehsan Ahmadi, Hunter Schofield, Behzad Khamidehi, Fazel Arasteh, Jinjun Shan, Lili Mou, Dongfeng Bai, Kasra Rezaee

Spatially Prompted Visual Trajectory Prediction for Egocentric Manipulation Manipulation

spatial prompting visual trajectory prediction egocentric manipulation end-effector motion 3D grounding

简要说明：本文形式化了以自我为中心操作的空间提示视觉轨迹预测（SP-VTP）任务，提出了一个数据集和一个模型（SPOT），该模型使用空间提示来预测末端执行器轨迹。

TLDR: This paper formalizes the Spatially Prompted Visual Trajectory Prediction (SP-VTP) task for egocentric manipulation, proposes a dataset and a model (SPOT) that uses spatial prompts to forecast end-effector trajectories.

Abstract: Robotic manipulation is often specified through language instructions or task identifiers, yet cluttered environments with similar objects are better handled by spatially indicating what to move and where to place it. Addressing the vision-centric challenge of object and goal specification, we present, to the best of our knowledge, the first formalization of Spatially Prompted Visual Trajectory Prediction (SP-VTP). This novel setting utilizes initial spatial prompts (like bounding boxes or points) to define task objectives, tasking the model with forecasting future end-effector trajectories from egocentric streams. To study this problem, we collect and annotate EgoSPT, a dataset of egocentric spatially prompted manipulation trajectories with first-frame object and target grounding annotations and recovered 3D end-effector motion. SP-VTP is challenging because the task specification is static, while the scene configuration evolves over time. To solve this problem, we propose SPOT(Spatially Prompted Object-Target Policy), which combines a task encoder for first-frame visual and coordinate spatial prompts, an observation encoder for current visual and history context, and a trajectory generator for future end-effector motion. Experiments under strict scene-level splits show that SPOT improves cross-scene trajectory prediction over non-prompted or single-source prompted baselines. Together, EgoSPT and SPOT establish a new spatial prompting problem SP-VTP, as a simple and scalable task condition for egocentric manipulation.

摘要（中文）：机器人操作通常通过语言指令或任务标识符来指定，然而在处理包含相似物体的杂乱环境时，更有效的方法是空间指示移动对象及放置位置。针对以视觉为核心的对象与目标指定难题，我们首次提出了空间提示视觉轨迹预测（SP-VTP）的形式化框架。这一新设定利用初始空间提示（如边界框或点）来定义任务目标，要求模型根据第一视角视频流预测未来末端执行器的运动轨迹。为研究该问题，我们收集并标注了EgoSPT数据集，其中包含第一视角空间提示操作轨迹，配有首帧对象与目标定位标注及重建的三维末端执行器运动数据。SP-VTP的挑战在于任务提示是静态的，而场景配置却随时间动态演变。为解决此问题，我们提出SPOT（空间提示对象-目标策略）模型，该模型结合了用于处理首帧视觉与坐标空间提示的任务编码器、用于解析当前视觉与历史场景的观察编码器，以及生成未来末端执行器运动轨迹的轨迹生成器。在严格场景划分下的实验表明，SPOT相较于无提示或单源提示的基线模型，显著提升了跨场景轨迹预测性能。EgoSPT数据集与SPOT模型共同构建了空间提示新课题SP-VTP，为第一视角操作任务提供了一种简洁且可扩展的任务条件框架。

Authors: Yifan Li, Xinyu Zhou, Yunhao Ge, Yu Kong

Real-World On-Vehicle Evaluation of Embedding-Based Anomaly Detection AutonomousDriving

anomaly detection vision transformer embeddings real-world evaluation autonomous driving patch-wise processing

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于自动驾驶的实时、基于嵌入的异常检测方法，该方法利用与预训练视觉变换器嵌入的块级相似度，并在真实自动驾驶车辆上进行了评估。

TLDR: The paper proposes a real-time, embedding-based anomaly detection method for autonomous driving, using patch-wise similarity to pretrained vision transformer embeddings and evaluated on a real automated vehicle.

Abstract: Detecting anomalies in traffic scenes is crucial for ensuring safety in autonomous driving, yet collecting representative anomalous data remains challenging. Existing anomaly detection methods are highly specialized and rely on normality as defined by the abstract semantic Cityscapes classes, making it difficult to adapt to diverse real-world scenarios. We propose an adaptable real-time anomaly detection method that leverages foundation models in the form of pretrained vision transformer embeddings to detect deviations via nearest-neighbor similarity in the latent semantic feature space. Based on patch-wise processing, the algorithm produces dense anomaly masks, allowing for the localization of detected anomalies. The method robustly models normality through a single reference image. This formulation avoids explicit supervision and dataset-specific training, making it suitable for real-world deployment. We evaluate the method on standard benchmarks and on an automated vehicle in real-world scenarios. Despite its simplicity, the method achieves good performance on the Road Anomaly benchmark and demonstrates consistent qualitative behavior in practice, successfully highlighting semantically unusual objects in diverse scenes. These results suggest that simple, reference-based methods can provide useful anomaly signals under realistic operating conditions.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 在交通场景中检测异常对于保障自动驾驶安全至关重要，然而收集具有代表性的异常数据仍具挑战性。现有异常检测方法高度专业化，且依赖于抽象语义Cityscapes类别所定义的常态，难以适应多样化的真实场景。我们提出一种适应性强的实时异常检测方法，该方法利用预训练视觉Transformer嵌入作为基础模型，通过在潜在语义特征空间中进行最近邻相似度计算来检测偏差。基于分块处理，算法生成密集的异常掩码，从而实现对检测异常的定位。该方法仅通过单张参考图像即可稳健建模常态，其设计避免了显式监督和针对特定数据集的训练，适合实际部署。我们在标准测试基准和真实场景中的自动驾驶车辆上对该方法进行评估。尽管方法简单，但其在Road Anomaly基准测试中取得了良好性能，并在实践中展现出稳定的定性表现，能成功突显不同场景中语义异常物体。这些结果表明，基于参考的简单方法可在实际运行条件下提供有效的异常信号。

Authors: Albert Schotschneider, Daniel Bogdoll, Svetlana Pavlitska, Ahmed Abouelazm, Johann Marius Zoellner

Aero-World: Action-Conditioned Aerial Video Generation from Inertial Controls WorldModel

action-conditioned video generation aerial video generation latent diffusion transformer inertial-consistency supervision Physics Probe

简要说明：Aero-World将预训练的扩散模型转换为可控的无人机视频生成器，以惯性控制信号为条件，通过冻结的Physics Probe提供惯性一致性监督，并提出了AeroBench评估基准。

TLDR: Aero-World adapts a pretrained image-to-video diffusion model to generate aerial videos conditioned on low-level inertial control signals, using a frozen Physics Probe for inertial-consistency supervision and proposing the AeroBench evaluation benchmark.

Abstract: Foundation video models produce visually impressive results, but their use in embodied AI remains limited because they are primarily trained on natural language rather than low-level control signals. This limitation is especially pronounced for aerial flight, where motion occurs in unconstrained 6-DoF space and small errors in ego-motion can produce large trajectory drift. Generating aerial videos that follow fine-grained inertial actions can support scalable training and evaluation of aerial agents by providing a controllable proxy for real-world or expensive simulation data. To address this problem, we propose \textbf{Aero-World}, a method for converting a pretrained image-to-video diffusion model into a controllable aerial video generator. Aero-World injects sequences of translational acceleration and angular velocity into a pretrained latent diffusion transformer through an action-token stream. A frozen latent-space Physics Probe, trained independently on real video--IMU pairs, provides differentiable inertial-consistency supervision during LoRA finetuning while avoiding computationally expensive video decoding. We further propose \textbf{AeroBench}, a benchmark for evaluating whether generated drone videos adhere to low-level action signals. AeroBench uses Action Alignment Score (AAS) to measure agreement with commanded inertial actions and Physical Consistency Rate (PCR) to measure temporal motion stability. On AeroBench, Aero-World improves mean AAS from 57.7 to 63.6 over action-only finetuning and gives a stronger quality-control trade-off than AirScape, with lower FVD (596.5 vs. 1058.6), higher SSIM (0.595 vs. 0.505), and higher Flow-IMU correlation (0.44 vs. 0.20). These results suggest that frozen Physics Probe supervision is a practical mechanism for adapting pretrained video generators toward more action-aligned aerial motion.

摘要（中文）：基础视频模型能生成视觉上令人印象深刻的结果，但它们在具身人工智能中的应用仍有限，因为其主要训练数据是自然语言而非低级控制信号。这一局限在航空飞行领域尤为突出，因为运动发生在无约束的六自由度空间，且自运动的微小误差可能导致巨大的轨迹漂移。生成遵循精细惯性动作的航拍视频，可为真实世界或高成本仿真数据提供可控替代，从而支持航空智能体的可扩展训练与评估。为解决这一问题，我们提出**Aero-World**——一种将预训练的图像转视频扩散模型转化为可控航拍视频生成器的方法。该方法通过动作令牌流，将平移加速度与角速度序列注入预训练的潜在扩散Transformer中。基于真实视频-IMU数据对独立训练的冻结潜在空间物理探针，在LoRA微调期间提供可微分的惯性一致性监督，同时避免计算开销巨大的视频解码。我们进一步提出**AeroBench**基准测试，用于评估生成的无人机视频是否遵循低级动作信号。该基准采用动作对齐分数（AAS）衡量与指令惯性动作的一致性，并利用物理一致性率（PCR）评估时序运动稳定性。在AeroBench测试中，相比纯动作微调方案，Aero-World将平均AAS从57.7提升至63.6，并展现出比AirScape更优的质量-控制权衡——其FVD更低（596.5对比1058.6）、SSIM更高（0.595对比0.505）、光流-IMU相关性更强（0.44对比0.20）。这些结果表明，冻结物理探针监督机制能有效将预训练视频生成器适配至更符合动作要求的航空运动场景。

Authors: Abdul Mohaimen Al Radi, Kunyang Li, Yuzhang Shang, Mubarak Shah, Yu Tian

Rethinking Muon Beyond Pretraining: Spectral Failures and High-Pass Remedies for VLA and RLVR VLA

optimizer VLA training RLVR spectral whitening robot manipulation

简要说明：本文提出Pion优化器，作为Muon的即插即用替代，通过引入高通谱滤波器解决VLA训练和RLVR中的梯度放大问题，在机器人操作任务上提升了性能。

TLDR: The paper proposes Pion, a drop-in replacement for the Muon optimizer that introduces a high-pass spectral filter to address gradient amplification issues in VLA training and RLVR, improving performance on robot manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Muon is a matrix-aware optimizer that leverages Newton-Schulz (NS) iterations to enforce spectral gradient orthogonalization by driving all singular values of the momentum matrix toward 1. While this uniform spectral whitening enhances exploration and outperforms AdamW in LLM pretraining, we show it could lead to fundamental limitations beyond pretraining in two regimes: (i) cross-modality vision-language-action (VLA) training, where inherently low-rank action-module gradients cause amplification of noisy tail directions, and (ii) reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), where low-SNR gradients and the need to preserve per-head specialization from prior training make whitening unstable. To address these challenges, we propose Pion, a drop-in replacement for Muon that preserves its computational efficiency while replacing uniform spectral whitening with a two-stage Promotion+Suppression mechanism, which we call the high-pass NS iteration. This design induces a sharp spectral high-pass effect, anchoring dominant singular values at 1 while suppressing noisy tail components toward 0, with controllable filter strength. To preserve pretrained per-head heterogeneity, Pion also supports a per-head mode that applies updates independently across attention heads via a simple reshape, at no extra cost. In VLA training on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, Pion consistently outperforms both baselines across l_1-regression (VLA-Adapter) and flow-matching (VLANeXt) architectures, e.g., reaching 100% success rate on LIBERO Object after 1,500 training steps with VLA-Adapter, vs. 97.0% for Muon and only 32.2% for AdamW. The advantage of Pion further extends to a real Franka Research 3 robot with a pi_0.5 backbone under the DROID setup on three grasp-and-place tasks. In RLVR post-training on Qwen3-1.7B/4B with GRPO and GMPO, Pion also outperforms AdamW on MATH and GSM8K while Muon collapses to zero.

摘要（中文）：μon是一种矩阵感知的优化器，它利用牛顿-舒尔茨迭代通过将动量矩阵的所有奇异值驱向1来实现谱梯度正交化。尽管这种均匀的谱白化在大型语言模型预训练中增强了探索性并优于AdamW，但我们发现它在预训练之外的两种场景中存在根本性局限：（i）跨模态视觉-语言-动作训练中，固有的低秩动作模块梯度会导致噪声尾端方向的放大；（ii）具有可验证奖励的强化学习中，低信噪比梯度以及需要保留先前训练中每个注意力头专业化的需求使得白化过程变得不稳定。为解决这些问题，我们提出Pion——一种可直接替代μon的方案，它在保持计算效率的同时，将均匀谱白化替换为两阶段的“促进+抑制”机制，即高通牛顿-舒尔茨迭代。该设计产生显著的谱高通效应：将主导奇异值锚定在1，同时将噪声尾端分量抑制至0，且滤波器强度可调。为保留预训练中的头部异构性，Pion还支持按注意力头独立更新的模式，通过简单的维度重塑实现且无需额外开销。在LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus数据集上的视觉-语言-动作训练中，Pion在l1回归（VLA-Adapter）和流匹配（VLANeXt）架构上均优于基线模型：例如使用VLA-Adapter在1500训练步后达到LIBERO Object任务100%成功率，而μon为97.0%，AdamW仅32.2%。在DROID设置下使用π_0.5骨干网络的真实Franka Research 3机器人上，Pion在三个抓取放置任务中的优势进一步扩展。在Qwen3-1.7B/4B模型使用GRPO和GMPO的强化学习可验证奖励后训练中，Pion在MATH和GSM8K数据集上的表现同样超越AdamW，而μon则完全失效。

Authors: Chongyu Fan, Gaowen Liu, Mingyi Hong, Ramana Rao Kompella, Sijia Liu

TravExplorer: Cross-Floor Embodied Exploration via Traversability-Aware 3-D Planning VLN

cross-floor embodied exploration traversability-aware 3D planning open-vocabulary segmentation volumetric map hierarchical planner

简要说明：该论文提出了TravExplorer，一个跨楼层具身探索框架，它结合了零样本语义引导与可通行性感知的三维规划及主动感知，用于多楼层室内环境中的开放词汇目标搜索，并在仿真和真实四足机器人上得到验证。

TLDR: The paper introduces TravExplorer, a cross-floor embodied exploration framework that integrates zero-shot semantic guidance with traversability-aware 3D planning and active perception for open-vocabulary target search in multi-floor indoor environments, validated in simulation and on a real quadruped robot.

Abstract: Zero-shot Object Navigation (ZSON) has shown promise for open-vocabulary target search in unseen environments, yet most existing systems remain tied to planar representations and single-floor assumptions. These assumptions become inadequate in real buildings, where navigation involves floors, stairs, landings, and vertically overlapping spaces. This article presents TravExplorer, a cross-floor embodied exploration framework that couples zero-shot semantic guidance with traversability-aware 3-D planning. TravExplorer maintains a unified volumetric map that distinguishes occupied structures from robot-reachable support surfaces and extracts traversable frontiers from connected support surfaces, including floors, stairs, and landings. A FOV-aware active perception strategy further resolves incomplete observations during cross-floor traversal. To reduce semantic-reasoning latency, a lightweight guidance module aligns a probabilistic instance map from online open-vocabulary segmentation with a spatial value map from fast image-to-text matching. Based on these geometric and semantic memories, a hierarchical planner performs target-aware frontier touring over object hypotheses, traversable frontiers, and stair landmarks, and generates executable cross-floor motions through foothold-guided 3-D search and vertically constrained local trajectory optimization. Experiments over 4,195 simulated episodes on HM3D and MP3D demonstrate consistent advantages over representative ObjectNav baselines. Fifty real-world trials on a Unitree Go2 further validate open-vocabulary target search across single-floor and cross-floor indoor environments without prior maps or human intervention. The code will be released at https://github.com/wuyi2121/TravExplorer.

摘要（中文）：零样本目标导航在未知环境中展现出开放词汇目标搜索的潜力，但现有系统大多仍局限于平面表示与单楼层假设。这些假设在真实建筑场景中难以适用，因为实际导航涉及楼层、楼梯、平台及垂直重叠空间。本文提出TravExplorer，一种跨楼层具身探索框架，将零样本语义引导与可通行性感知的三维规划相结合。该框架通过统一体素地图区分占据结构与机器人可达支撑面，并从连接的支撑面（包括地板、楼梯和平台）中提取可通行边界。基于视场感知的主动感知策略进一步解决跨楼层遍历过程中的观测不完整问题。为降低语义推理延迟，轻量级引导模块将在线开放词汇分割生成的概率实例地图与快速图像-文本匹配生成的空间价值地图进行对齐。基于几何与语义记忆，分层规划器在目标假设、可通行边界及楼梯地标上进行目标感知的边界巡游，并通过立足点引导的三维搜索与垂直约束的局部轨迹优化生成可执行的跨楼层运动。在HM3D与MP3D数据集上进行的4,195次仿真实验表明，该方法较代表性目标导航基线具有持续优势。在Unitree Go2机器人上进行的50次真实场景试验进一步验证了该框架在无先验地图或人工干预条件下，对单楼层及跨楼层室内环境开放词汇目标搜索的有效性。代码发布于https://github.com/wuyi2121/TravExplorer。

Authors: Han Zheng, Zhe Chen, Yudong Huang, Haoran Liu, Jinghao Wang, Ming Yang, Tong Qin

Trajectory Planning and Control near the Limits: an Open Experimental Benchmark on the RoboRacer Platform AutonomousDriving

trajectory planning control autonomous driving inverse dynamics model-structured neural network

简要说明：该论文提出了一个用于极限场景下轨迹规划与控制的实验基准，使用1:10比例的RoboRacer平台，并提出了一个用于逆动力学的模型结构化神经网络。

TLDR: The paper presents an experimental benchmark for trajectory planning and control in high-acceleration, limit-pushing autonomous driving scenarios, using a 1:10-scale RoboRacer platform and proposing a model-structured neural network for inverse dynamics.

Abstract: We present a modular framework to benchmark new and existing methods for trajectory planning and control in high-acceleration maneuvers that push autonomous driving to the limits. Our framework includes time-optimal raceline generation, online time-optimal velocity replanning, geometric path tracking controllers, and a new model-structured neural network (MS-NN) to learn the inverse dynamics for steering control. We deploy our framework on a 1:10-scale RoboRacer platform, using two circuits. Through several ablations with cautious and aggressive racelines, we study the performance of single modules and their combinations. We show that our MS-NN significantly improves tracking accuracy, decreases steering oscillations, and is physically interpretable. Moreover, online velocity replanning improves lap times by compensating for execution errors, and enables the vehicle to safely reach higher speeds and accelerations. To support future research, our code, datasets, videos and results are publicly available at https://roboracer-benchmark.github.io/planning_control_benchmark/.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种模块化框架，用于在极限条件下验证自动驾驶中高加速度机动轨迹规划与控制的新方法和现有方法。该框架包含时间最优参考线生成、在线时间最优速度重规划、几何路径跟踪控制器，以及一种新型模型结构化神经网络（MS-NN）用于学习转向控制的反向动力学模型。我们在1:10比例的RoboRacer平台上部署了该框架，并在两条赛道上进行测试。通过保守与激进两种参考线策略的多组对照实验，我们评估了各独立模块及其组合的性能。研究表明，我们的MS-NN模型显著提升了轨迹跟踪精度，减少了转向振荡，且具有物理可解释性。此外，在线速度重规划通过补偿执行误差有效缩短了单圈用时，使车辆能够安全达到更高的速度与加速度。为支持后续研究，我们的代码、数据集、演示视频及实验结果已在https://roboracer-benchmark.github.io/planning_control_benchmark/公开。

Authors: Mattia Piccinini, Patrick Zambiasi, Aniello Mungiello, Mattia Piazza, Felix Jahncke, Johannnes Betz

From Prompts to Pavement Through Time: Temporal Grounding in Agentic Scene-to-Plan Reasoning AutonomousDriving

temporal grounding agentic reasoning autonomous vehicles scene-to-plan LLM ensembles

简要说明：本文研究了时间条件控制在自动驾驶规划中多智能体LLM/LMM集成的影响，发现在标准NLP指标上无显著量化提升，但在风险推理和行为稳定性上具有定性益处。

TLDR: This paper investigates the impact of temporal conditioning in multi-agent LLM/LMM ensembles for autonomous driving planning, finding no quantitative improvement in NLP metrics but qualitative benefits in hazard reasoning and behavior stability.

Abstract: Recent attempts to support high-level scene interpretation and planning in Autonomous Vehicles (AVs) using ensembles of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) continue to treat time as a secondary property. This lack of temporal grounding leads to inconsistencies in reasoning about continuous actions, undermining both safety and interpretability. This work explores whether temporal conditioning within inter-agent communication can preserve or enhance coherence without introducing degradation in semantic or logical consistency. To investigate this, we introduce three planner architectures with progressively increasing temporal integration and evaluate them on curated subsets of the BDD-X dataset using semantic, syntactic, and logical metrics. Results show that while temporal conditioning reshapes reasoning style, it yields no statistically significant improvements in standard NLP-based correctness metrics. However, qualitative analysis reveals predictive hazard reasoning, stable corrective behavior, and strategic divergence in the Sentinel. These findings clarify the limits of prompt-based temporal grounding and establish the first empirical benchmark for temporal scene-to-plan reasoning.

摘要（中文）：近期利用大型语言模型（LLM）与大型多模态模型（LMM）集成来支持自动驾驶车辆高级场景理解与规划的研究，仍将时间视为次要属性。这种时间基准的缺失导致对连续动作的推理存在不一致性，既影响了安全性，也损害了可解释性。本研究探讨智能体间通信中的时序条件设置能否在不破坏语义或逻辑一致性的前提下维持或提升系统协调性。为此，我们提出了三种时序融合程度递增的规划器架构，并基于BDD-X数据集的精选子集，通过语义、句法和逻辑指标进行评估。结果表明，虽然时序条件设置会改变推理模式，但在基于自然语言处理的常规正确性指标上并未产生统计显著的改进。然而，定性分析揭示了前瞻性风险推理、稳定的校正行为以及哨兵机制中的策略分歧。这些发现明确了基于提示的时序基准方法的局限性，并为时序场景到规划的推理建立了首个实证基准。

Authors: Ahmed Y. Gado, Omar Y. Goba, Alaa Hassanein, Catherine M. Elias, Ahmed Hussein

FlyMirage: A Fully Automated Generation Pipeline for Diverse and Scalable UAV Flight Data via Generative World Model VLN

Vision-Language Navigation generative world model 3D Gaussian Splatting UAV trajectory generation data generation pipeline

简要说明：FlyMirage提出了一种全自动生成流程，利用大型语言模型作为环境设计器，并结合生成式世界模型，生成了一个大规模、真实感、具有可行飞行轨迹的空中视觉语言导航数据集。

TLDR: FlyMirage introduces a fully automated pipeline that uses an LLM as an environment designer and a generative world model to create a large-scale, photorealistic aerial VLN dataset with feasible UAV trajectories.

Abstract: In the field of Vision-Language Navigation (VLN), aerial datasets remain limited in their ability to combine scale, diversity, and realism, often relying on either costly real-world scenes or visually limited simulations. To address these challenges, we introduce FlyMirage, a highly scalable and fully automated data generation pipeline for aerial VLN. Our approach leverages large language models (LLM) as an environment designer to promote scene diversity, paired with a generative world model that instantiates these designs into high-fidelity 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes. To substantially reduce human labor and ensure the feasibility of flight data, FlyMirage automates scene exploration and semantic information acquisition, and further integrates a dynamically feasible planner for uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV) trajectory generation. Utilizing this toolchain, we generate a large-scale, diverse, and photorealistic aerial VLN dataset, with dynamically feasible flying trajectories, designed to support the development of next-generation embodied navigation models.

摘要（中文）：在视觉语言导航（VLN）领域，现有航空数据集在融合规模、多样性和真实性方面仍存在局限，往往依赖成本高昂的真实场景或视觉表现受限的模拟环境。为解决这些挑战，本研究提出FlyMirage——一个高度可扩展的全自动航空VLN数据生成流程。该方案采用大型语言模型作为环境设计器以提升场景多样性，并配合生成式世界模型将这些设计实例化为高保真度的3D高斯溅射（3DGS）场景。为大幅降低人力成本并确保飞行数据的可行性，FlyMirage实现了场景探索与语义信息获取的自动化，进一步集成了动态可行性规划器以生成无人机飞行轨迹。通过该工具链，我们构建了规模庞大、多样性强、具有照片级真实感的航空VLN数据集，其中包含动态可行的飞行轨迹，旨在支持新一代具身导航模型的研发。

Authors: Jinhan Li, Xijie Huang, Zhaoqi Wang, Yijin Wang, Weiqi Ge, Qiyi He, Mo Zhu, Fei Gao, Yuze Wu, Xin Zhou

MCNav: Memory-Aware Dynamic Cognitive Map for Zero-shot Goal-oriented Navigation VLN

zero-shot navigation cognitive map memory-aware exploration instance-level goal visual navigation

简要说明：提出MCNav，一种用于零样本目标导向导航的记忆感知动态认知地图框架，通过目标重新验证和错失目标重新探索策略，在HM3D数据集上实现最先进的实例级目标导航性能。

TLDR: Proposes MCNav, a zero-shot goal-oriented navigation framework with a dynamic cognitive map and memory-aware exploration strategies, achieving SOTA on instance-level goal navigation in HM3D datasets.

Abstract: Navigating to instance-level targets in complex environments is a challenging problem. Many existing zero-shot methods achieve strong performance by modeling the entire environment and leveraging large language models for scene understanding. However, such strategies primarily focus on exploring new regions while lacking a deeper exploitation of information from previously explored areas. Consequently, when targets are missed or misidentified within previously visited regions, navigation failures occur frequently. To address these limitations, we propose MCNav, a memory-aware navigation framework with a dynamic cognitive map. This map stores efficiently queryable information about relevant objects in explored areas. Building on this memory structure, MCNav introduces two memory-aware exploration strategies: goal re-validation, which re-assesses previously seen objects to correct matching failures, and missed goal re-exploration, which estimates the likelihood that a target is present in an explored region from contextual cues. These strategies are further stabilized by a blacklist mechanism to prevent repeated errors and a double-check mechanism for high-confidence confirmation. We evaluate MCNav on the HM3Dv1 and HM3Dv2 datasets across three different tasks, where it achieves state-of-the-art performance, particularly on the instance-level goal navigation task.

摘要（中文）：在复杂环境中导航至实例级目标是一项具有挑战性的问题。现有许多零样本方法通过建模整个环境并利用大型语言模型进行场景理解，取得了出色性能。然而，这类策略主要侧重于探索新区域，而缺乏对已探索区域信息的深度挖掘。因此，当目标在已访问区域中被遗漏或误识别时，导航失败频繁发生。为应对这些局限，我们提出了MCNav——一种基于动态认知地图的记忆感知导航框架。该地图高效存储了已探索区域内相关对象的可查询信息。基于这一记忆结构，MCNav引入了两种记忆感知探索策略：目标重验证策略通过对已观测对象进行重新评估来修正匹配失败，以及遗漏目标再探索策略通过上下文线索预估目标存在于已探索区域的可能性。这些策略通过防止重复错误的黑名单机制和用于高置信度确认的双重检查机制得到进一步稳定。我们在HM3Dv1和HM3Dv2数据集上针对三项不同任务评估MCNav，其性能均达到最优水平，尤其在实例级目标导航任务中表现突出。

Authors: Jingyu Li, Zhe Liu, Wenxiao Wu, Li Zhang

ARC-RL: A Reinforcement Learning Playground Inspired by ARC Raiders Locomotion

reinforcement learning legged locomotion MuJoCo morphological diversity central pattern generator

简要说明：本文提出ARC-RL，一套包含四种受游戏启发腿式机器人形态的MuJoCo环境，采用统一奖励函数，并研究了用于运动控制的强化学习算法。

TLDR: The paper introduces ARC-RL, a suite of MuJoCo environments with four legged robot morphologies inspired by a game, featuring a unified reward function and a study of RL algorithms for locomotion control.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning for legged locomotion has matured into a stack of multi-component reward functions and physics-engine benchmarks whose morphologies are uniformly derived from real commercial hardware. Game NPCs, however, are bound by stylistic constraints absent from sim-to-real robotics and routinely take the form of creatures with no real-robot counterpart. We introduce ARC-RL, a suite of four MuJoCo continuous-control environments featuring robotic morphologies inspired by the bestiary of ARC Raiders: the 18-DoF tall hexapod Queen, the 12-DoF armoured hexapod Bastion, the 18-DoF compact hexapod Tick, and the 12-DoF quadruped Leaper. All four robots share a unified observation template, action convention, simulation cadence, and a single closed-form multi-component reward function whose only per-morphology variation lives in a small set of weights and parameters. The reward fuses a velocity-tracking tent, a healthy survive bonus, a phase-locked gait-compliance bonus/cost pair, action regularisers, three safety penalties, and a posture anchor; no motion-capture data enters the reward at any point. We additionally provide hand-crafted Central Pattern Generator demonstrators per morphology, which serve both as fixed expert references and as sources of prior data for offline-to-online training. On this playground, we conduct a controlled empirical study comparing standard online algorithms (SAC, SPEQ, SOPE-EO) and methods augmented with prior data (SACfD, SPEQ-O2O, SOPE), and characterise how each paradigm copes with the playground's morphological diversity and animation-style stylistic constraints. Source code is available at https://github.com/CarloRomeo427/ARC_RL.git.

摘要（中文）：面向足式移动的强化学习已发展为一套多组件奖励函数与物理引擎基准测试体系，其形态结构普遍源自现实商业硬件。然而，游戏NPC受限于风格化约束——这类约束在仿真到现实的机器人学中并不存在，并常以现实中无对应机器人的生物形态呈现。我们提出ARC-RL——一套包含四个MuJoCo连续控制环境的测试平台，其机器人形态设计灵感来源于《ARC Raiders》兽谱：18自由度高型六足"女王"、12自由度装甲六足"堡垒"、18自由度紧凑六足"蜱虫"以及12自由度四足"跳跃者"。四款机器人共享统一的观测模板、动作规范、仿真步频，以及一个闭式多组件奖励函数，该函数仅通过少量权重与参数实现形态间的差异化调整。该奖励函数融合了速度追踪目标、生存奖励、相位同步步态顺应性奖励/惩罚对、动作正则项、三项安全惩罚以及姿态锚定项，全程未使用任何动作捕捉数据。我们同时为每种形态提供了手工设计的中央模式生成器示范控制器，既可作为固定专家参考，也可作为离线至在线训练的优先数据源。在此测试平台上，我们开展了对照实验研究，比较了标准在线算法（SAC、SPEQ、SOPE-EO）与结合优先数据增强的方法（SACfD、SPEQ-O2O、SOPE），并系统分析了各类方法如何应对平台中的形态多样性及动画风格约束。源代码发布于https://github.com/CarloRomeo427/ARC_RL.git。

Authors: Carlo Romeo, Andrew D. Bagdanov

Self-assembling Modular Aerial Robot for Versatile Aerial Tasks Manipulation

self-assembling modular aerial robot cooperative manipulation in-flight docking articulated motion

简要说明：一种自组装模块化空中机器人系统，通过自主空中对接，实现了灵活的个体飞行和集体的铰接式操作，完成了核心的空中操控任务。

TLDR: A self-assembling modular aerial robot system enables nimble individual flight and collective, articulated manipulation through autonomous in-flight docking, realizing core aerial manipulation primitives.

Abstract: Multirotor aerial robots excel at maneuvering in three-dimensional space, and recent advances enable nimble navigation in cluttered and confined environments, especially for small airframes. By contrast, platforms built for high-altitude work tend to be larger to deliver high thrust for stable physical interaction with the environment. However, these conflicting design requirements create a long-standing trade-off between nimble navigation and robust aerial manipulation. Here, we present LEGION units, which are reconfigurable modular aerial robots capable of in-flight self-assembly for cooperative manipulation, drawing inspiration from the self-organized collectives formed by ants. Each unit retains nimble maneuverability while joint-equipped docking interfaces at both ends enable end-to-end self-assembly into a flying manipulator. We show that multiple units autonomously dock in flight; once latched, they maintain a zero-clearance interlock by controlling the contact force and torque, enabling reliable aggregation and articulated motion even outdoors. We further show that self-reconfigurability enables morphological switching between nimble individual flight and collective articulated manipulation, while realizing core in-flight manipulation primitives including pushing, pulling, rotating, grasping, and carrying. LEGION's self-organization enables aerial robots, especially in swarms, to shift from passive observers to active participants in their environment, broadening the scope of aerial physical interaction.

摘要（中文）：多旋翼空中机器人在三维空间中展现出卓越的机动性能，近年来在杂乱与狭窄环境下的敏捷导航技术尤其针对小型机架取得了显著进展。相比之下，为高空作业设计的平台往往体积更大，以提供强推力从而实现与环境的稳定物理交互。然而，这些相互矛盾的设计要求长期迫使敏捷导航与鲁棒空中操纵间做出权衡。本文提出LEGION单元——一种受蚂蚁自组织集群启发的可重构模块化空中机器人，具备飞行中自组装能力以实现协同操作。每个单元在保持敏捷机动性的同时，通过两端配备关节的对接接口，可实现端到端自组装为飞行机械臂。我们展示了多个单元在空中自主对接的能力：一旦锁定，它们通过控制接触力与扭矩维持零间隙互锁，即使在户外也能实现可靠的聚合与关节式运动。进一步实验表明，自重构能力使得系统能够在敏捷单体飞行与集群关节式操作两种形态间灵活切换，并实现了推、拉、旋转、抓取、携带等核心飞行操纵功能。LEGION的自组织特性使空中机器人（尤其是集群系统）得以从被动观察者转变为环境中的主动参与者，从而拓展了空中物理交互的应用边界。

Authors: Junichiro Sugihara, Masaki Kitagawa, Jinjie Li, Yunong Li, Takuzumi Nishio, Kei Okada, Moju Zhao

Bilateral Teleoperation with Compliant 6-DOF Pose-and-Force Sensing Manipulation

bilateral teleoperation compliant force sensing series elastic actuator impedance control hardware-agnostic middleware

简要说明：一个硬件无关的双边遥操作框架，使用顺从的6自由度力/位姿传感器作为串联弹性执行器，可在延迟和数据包丢失下稳定运行。

TLDR: A hardware-agnostic bilateral teleoperation framework using compliant 6-DOF force/pose sensors as series elastic actuators, enabling stable operation under delay and packet loss.

Abstract: Existing bilateral teleoperation platforms still rely on costly rigid six-axis force/torque sensors, tightly coupled leader-follower hardware, and kilohertz control loops. We present a Cartesian bilateral framework built on the hardware-agnostic WinGs Operating Studio (WOS) middleware, in which a low-cost compliant 6-DOF pose-and-force sensing end-effector, Delta6, is mounted on both sides so that each manipulator behaves as an end-effector 6-DOF series elastic actuator (SEA). The leader runs a damping-only admittance loop with a 6-D biquad notch filter; the follower realizes a stiffness-damping impedance through a position-based outer loop with a PID wrench-to-pose mapping. Three time scales (hardware I/O, mid-rate impedance/admittance, low-rate teleoperation messages) are explicitly decoupled, enabling the same application to drive heterogeneous arms. On a Lite6/FR3 testbed at 150 Hz, the system tracks stably under delays up to $120\pm40$ ms and 1% packet loss, matches the prescribed virtual stiffness in contact, and shows a favorable cumulative energy signature in passivity-style tests.

摘要（中文）：现有的双边遥操作平台仍然依赖于昂贵的刚性六轴力/扭矩传感器、紧密耦合的主从端硬件以及千赫兹级控制回路。本文提出一种基于硬件无关的WinGs操作工作室（WOS）中间件的笛卡尔式双边遥操作框架。该框架在双侧均配置低成本柔性六自由度位姿-力传感末端执行器Delta6，使各机械臂可等效为末端六自由度串联弹性执行器（SEA）。主端采用带六维双二阶陷波滤波器的纯阻尼导纳控制回路；从端通过基于位置的外环结合PID力矩-位姿映射实现刚度-阻尼阻抗控制。系统明确解耦了三个时间尺度（硬件I/O、中速阻抗/导纳控制、低速遥操作通信），使得同一应用能驱动异构机械臂。在150赫兹频率的Lite6/FR3测试平台上，系统在高达$120\pm40$毫秒延迟和1%数据包丢失条件下仍能稳定跟踪，接触状态下与预设虚拟刚度匹配，并在类无源性测试中呈现出良好的累积能量特性。

Authors: Yue Feng, Weicheng Huang, I-Ming Chen

Graph Neural Planning and Predictive Control for Multi-Robot Communication-Constrained Unlabeled Motion Planning RLRobot

Multi-Robot Motion Planning Graph Neural Network Nonlinear Model Predictive Control Decentralized Control Quadrotor

简要说明：提出一个结合图注意力规划器和分散式非线性模型预测控制的层次框架，用于解决通信约束下的多机器人无标定运动规划问题，并在四旋翼上进行验证。

TLDR: A hierarchical framework combining Graph ATtention Planner and decentralized NMPC for multi-robot motion planning under communication constraints, validated on quadrotors.

Abstract: The multi-robot unlabeled motion planning problem of concurrently assigning robots to goals and generating safe trajectories is central in many collaborative tasks. Recent Graph Neural Network methods offer scalable decentralized solutions but rely on simplified dynamics and simulation environments, overlooking key challenges of real-world deployment such as dynamic feasibility and communication constraints. To address these gaps, we propose a hierarchical framework that combines a Graph ATtention Planner (GATP) with a decentralized Nonlinear Model Predictive Controller (NMPC). GATP provides intermediate subgoals through multi-robot cooperation, and the NMPC enforces safety under nonlinear dynamics and actuation constraints. We evaluate our framework in both simulation and real-world quadrotor experiments. Thanks to attention mechanisms and minimal communication requirements, we demonstrate improved generalization to larger teams, robustness to communication delays up to 200 ms and practical feasibility with decentralized on-board inference.

摘要（中文）：多机器人无标签运动规划问题涉及同时为机器人分配目标并生成安全轨迹，是众多协作任务中的核心课题。现有的图神经网络方法提供了可扩展的分布式解决方案，但依赖于简化的动力学与仿真环境，忽略了实际部署中的动态可行性及通信约束等关键挑战。为应对这些不足，本文提出一种分层框架，将图注意力规划器（GATP）与分布式非线性模型预测控制器（NMPC）相结合。GATP通过多机器人协作提供中间子目标，而NMPC在非线性动力学和执行器约束下保障运动安全。我们在仿真与实际四旋翼飞行器实验中验证了该框架的性能。得益于注意力机制和极低的通信需求，该方法在更大规模团队中表现出更强的泛化能力，能承受高达200毫秒的通信延迟，并可通过分布式机载推理实现实际部署。

Authors: Manohari Goarin, Yang Zhou, Giuseppe Loianno

Automatically Improving Simulation Physics for Articulated Objects Manipulation

simulation-ready objects articulated objects simulator-in-the-loop physical properties robot learning

简要说明：本论文提出了一种多模态、模拟器在环的方法，用于从非完整3D资产中自动生成交互就绪的关节化对象，从而提高仿真稳定性和下游机器人学习性能。

TLDR: This thesis introduces a multi-modal, simulator-in-the-loop approach to automatically generate interaction-ready articulated objects from incomplete 3D assets, improving simulation stability and downstream robot learning performance.

Abstract: Simulation is a central tool for scalable robot learning, but its effectiveness depends on the quality of object assets. While modern 3D datasets provide rich geometric and kinematic representations, they typically lack the physical properties required for stable and realistic interaction, requiring significant manual effort to construct simulation-ready articulated objects. In this thesis, we introduce interaction-readiness, which characterizes whether an object can be reliably simulated under manipulation. We propose a quantitative evaluation framework that decomposes interaction-readiness into measurable components, enabling systematic analysis of object quality and revealing failure modes not captured by conventional evaluation. We further present a multi-modal, simulator-in-the-loop approach for generating interaction-ready articulated objects from incomplete 3D assets. The method integrates geometric, visual, and semantic information to infer physical properties and refines them through iterative simulator feedback to improve physical consistency. Experiments across diverse articulated objects and manipulation tasks show that object quality directly impacts simulation stability, interaction behavior, and policy performance. Objects refined by our method exhibit more stable and realistic dynamics, enabling more reliable downstream learning and evaluation. Overall, this thesis demonstrates the importance of physical realism for articulated objects in simulation and introduces a practical multi-modal refinement approach, guided by simulator feedback, for constructing such objects at scale.

摘要（中文）：仿真技术是机器人规模化学习的关键工具，但其有效性依赖于物体模型的质量。尽管现代三维数据集提供了丰富的几何与运动学表示，它们通常缺乏实现稳定且真实交互所需的物理属性，需要大量人工干预才能构建适用于仿真的关节化物体模型。本文提出“交互就绪度”的概念，用于描述物体在操作过程中是否能够被可靠地仿真。我们设计了一种量化评估框架，将交互就绪度分解为可测量的要素，从而实现对物体质量的系统性分析，并揭示传统评估方法未能发现的失效模式。在此基础上，我们进一步提出一种多模态、仿真器在环的方法，能够从非完整的三维资产中生成具备交互就绪度的关节化物体。该方法融合几何、视觉与语义信息来推断物理属性，并通过迭代的仿真器反馈进行精细化调整，以提升物理一致性。在不同关节化物体与操作任务上的实验表明，物体质量直接影响仿真的稳定性、交互行为与策略性能。经本方法优化后的物体模型展现出更稳定且真实的动力学特性，能够支持更可靠的下游学习与评估。总之，本文论证了关节化物体物理真实性在仿真中的重要性，并提出了一种基于仿真器反馈的实用多模态精细化方法，为实现此类物体的大规模构建提供了可行路径。

Authors: Anh-Quan Pham

Neural Operators for Design-Space Surrogate Modeling of Tendon-Actuated Continuum Robots Manipulation

neural operators surrogate modeling tendon-driven continuum robots design generalization operator learning

简要说明：本文提出了用于肌腱驱动连续体机器人代理建模的神经算子架构，使单个训练好的模型能够泛化到不同的机器人设计，为控制、规划和设计优化提供快速准确的建模。

TLDR: This paper presents neural operator architectures for surrogate modeling of tendon-actuated continuum robots, enabling a single trained model to generalize across robot designs for fast and accurate modeling in control, planning, and design optimization.

Abstract: Continuum robots enable dexterous manipulation in constrained environments, but require accurate and efficient models for real-time manipulation and control. Traditional physics-based models can be computationally expensive and may suffer from inaccuracies due to unmodeled effects, while current learning-based methods often generalize poorly beyond the specific robot on which they are trained. We present a formulation of surrogate modeling for tendon-driven continuum robots as an operator learning problem that maps robot design parameters and tendon actuation inputs to resulting configurations. This formulation enables a single trained model to generalize across a large class of robot designs. We develop four novel neural operator architectures--two based on Deep Operator Networks (DeepONets) and two based on Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs)--and train them on simulation data to predict robot configurations. All architectures achieve good accuracy while allowing for fast and accurate generalization across designs. Our results demonstrate that operator learning provides an effective and generalizable surrogate for continuum robot mechanics in the design space, enabling fast modeling for control, planning, and design optimization in surgical and industrial applications.

摘要（中文）：连续体机器人能够在受限环境中实现灵巧操作，但需要精确高效的模型以实现实时操控与控制。传统基于物理的模型计算成本高昂，且可能因未建模效应而产生误差，而当前基于学习的方法往往难以泛化至训练所用特定机器人之外的范围。本研究将肌腱驱动连续体机器人的代理建模表述为算子学习问题，即将机器人设计参数与肌腱驱动输入映射至最终构型。该表述使得单个训练模型能够泛化至一大类机器人设计。我们开发了四种新型神经算子架构——两种基于深度算子网络（DeepONets），两种基于傅里叶神经算子（FNOs）——并利用仿真数据训练它们以预测机器人构型。所有架构均实现了较高精度，同时支持跨设计方案的快速准确泛化。实验结果表明，算子学习在设计空间中为连续体机器人力学提供了有效且可泛化的代理模型，能够为手术及工业应用中的控制、路径规划和设计优化提供快速建模支持。

Authors: Branden Frieden, James M. Ferguson, Alan Kuntz, Varun Shankar

Distributionally Robust Control via Stein Variational Inference for Contact-Rich Manipulation Manipulation

distributionally robust control Stein variational inference contact-rich manipulation model-based control parametric uncertainty

简要说明：该论文提出一种基于Stein变分推理的分布鲁棒控制方法，通过对任务敏感参数不确定性进行显式建模，提升接触密集型操作任务的可靠性。

TLDR: The paper proposes a distributionally robust control method using Stein variational inference to improve reliability in contact-rich manipulation tasks by explicitly modeling task-sensitive parameter uncertainty.

Abstract: Reliable robotic manipulation requires control policies that can accurately represent and adapt to uncertainty arising from contact-rich interactions. Modern data-driven methods mitigate uncertainty through large-scale training and computation, and degrade significantly in performance with limited number of training samples. By contrast, classical model-based controllers are computationally efficient and reliable, but their limited ability to represent task-relevant uncertainty can hinder performance in contact-rich interactions. In this work, we propose to expand the capabilities of model-based manipulation control through more flexible uncertainty modeling that retains performance while exactly adapting to uncertainty. Our approach casts the manipulation problem as a distributionally robust control optimization and proposes a novel deterministic formulation based on Stein variational inference that preserves performance while explicitly modeling task-sensitive parameter uncertainty. As a result, the derived controllers are more aware of task sensitivities to uncertainty, yielding high reliability without compromising performance. Experimental results demonstrate up to 3$\times$ improved robustness across a range of contact-rich manipulation tasks under broad parametric uncertainty, outperforming existing model-based control methods.

摘要（中文）：可靠的机器人操作需要控制策略能够准确表征并适应接触密集型交互中产生的不确定性。现代数据驱动方法通过大规模训练和计算来缓解不确定性，但在训练样本有限时性能会显著下降。相比之下，经典基于模型的控制方法具有计算效率高和可靠性强的优势，但其表征任务相关不确定性的能力有限，可能阻碍在接触密集型交互中的表现。 本研究提出通过更灵活的不确定性建模来拓展基于模型的操作控制能力，在精确适应不确定性的同时保持性能。我们的方法将操作问题构建为分布鲁棒控制优化，并基于斯坦变分推理提出一种新颖的确定性框架，该框架在显式建模任务敏感参数不确定性的同时保持性能。因此，所得控制器能更敏锐地感知任务对不确定性的敏感度，在不牺牲性能的前提下实现更高的可靠性。实验结果表明，在广泛参数不确定性条件下，该方法在一系列接触密集型操作任务中的鲁棒性提升高达3倍，超越了现有基于模型的控制方法。

Authors: Hrishikesh Sathyanarayan, Victor Vantilborgh, Harish Ravichandar, Tom Lefebvre, Ian Abraham

Adaptive Human-Robot Collaboration for Masonry Construction Under Material and Assembly Uncertainty Manipulation

Human-robot collaboration construction robotics tolerance accumulation projection guidance laser scanning

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于砌体施工的自适应人机协作工作流，利用末端执行器安装的投影引导和激光扫描进行反馈驱动校正，以减轻公差累积。

TLDR: The paper presents an adaptive human-robot collaborative workflow for masonry construction that uses end-effector-mounted projection guidance and laser scanning for feedback-driven correction to mitigate tolerance accumulation.

Abstract: Human-robot collaboration in construction is often challenged by limited robot-to-human communication and the need to adapt to tolerance accumulation arising from material and assembly uncertainties. We present an adaptive human-robot collaborative workflow for masonry construction that addresses communication limitations and tolerance accumulation, demonstrated through a brickwork case study in which a robot places bricks while a human applies adhesive. This workflow is enabled by two complementary mechanisms: 1) an end-effector-mounted projector that provides spatially registered, just-in-time projection guidance for manual adhesive application, and 2) laser scanning for feedback-driven grasping and placement pose correction. Together, these mechanisms enable adjustment of human and robotic actions in response to material variability and accumulated assembly tolerances. Full-scale experiments across conventional running-bond and nonstandard configurations demonstrate that projection guidance improves adhesive application consistency and reduces application time, while laser-based correction maintains level courses and avoids collision-prone failures associated with open-loop execution. These results indicate that integrating spatial projection with feedback-driven adaptation, enabled by material and as-built sensing, can mitigate tolerance accumulation and improve precision and robustness in human-robot collaborative construction.

摘要（中文）：建筑中的人机协作常面临两大挑战：机器人对人类的信息传递受限，以及需要适应材料和装配不确定性导致的公差累积。本文提出了一种适应性的砌筑施工人机协作流程，通过砖砌案例研究展示了该流程如何应对通信限制与公差累积问题——在该案例中，机器人负责砌砖，人类负责涂抹粘合剂。该流程由两项互补机制实现：1）安装于末端执行器的投影仪，为人工涂抹粘合剂提供空间定位的实时投影指引；2）通过激光扫描进行反馈驱动的抓取与放置位姿校正。这两项机制共同作用，使得人与机器人能根据材料变异性和累积装配公差调整各自动作。在传统顺砌与非标准构型的全尺寸实验中，投影指引显著提高了粘合剂涂抹的一致性并缩短了施工时间，而基于激光的校正技术则保持了层间水平度，避免了开环执行中易发生的碰撞故障。实验结果表明：通过材料与完工状态感知实现的空间投影与反馈驱动适应相结合，能够有效缓解公差累积问题，提升人机协作施工的精度与鲁棒性。

Authors: Jutang Gao, Arash Adel

Probabilistic Recursively Feasible Motion Planning Under Uncertain Environments AutonomousDriving

Model Predictive Control Recursive Feasibility Probabilistic Safety Motion Planning Uncertain Environments

简要说明：本文提出了一种概率递归可行模型预测控制框架，在不确定环境中以指定概率保证递归可行性，并在车道变换场景中进行了仿真验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a Probabilistic Recursively Feasible Model Predictive Control (PRF-MPC) framework that guarantees recursive feasibility with a specified probability in uncertain environments, demonstrated in a lane-change scenario.

Abstract: Safe motion planning in uncertain, time-varying environments is challenging because the safe region can change unpredictably across planning steps, often causing a loss of recursive feasibility. In this work, we present a Probabilistic Recursively Feasible Model Predictive Control (PRF-MPC) framework that guarantees recursive feasibility with a specified probability. We introduce properties that an ideal predictor should satisfy to ensure distributional consistency, and use these properties to derive closed-form expressions for the means and covariances of trajectories predicted at future time steps. Building on this analysis, we construct safety constraints that ensure, with high probability, that the current safe set is contained within the safe sets at future time steps, thereby probabilistically guaranteeing recursive feasibility. Simulation results on a lane-change scenario demonstrate that the proposed method significantly improves recursive feasibility.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 在不确定的时变环境中进行安全运动规划具有挑战性，因为安全区域可能随规划步骤发生不可预测的变化，常常导致递归可行性丧失。本文提出一种概率递归可行性模型预测控制（PRF-MPC）框架，能在指定概率下保证递归可行性。我们提出了理想预测器应满足的分布一致性条件，并利用这些条件推导出未来时间步轨迹预测均值与协方差的闭式表达式。基于此分析，我们构建了安全约束条件，确保当前安全集以高概率包含于未来时间步的安全集中，从而在概率意义上保证递归可行性。车道变换场景的仿真结果表明，所提方法显著提升了递归可行性。

Authors: Hyeontae Sung, Hyeongchan Ham, Junyoung Park, Kai Ren, Heejin Ahn

Adversarial Stress Testing of SPARK Humanoid Safety Filters HumanoidEmbodied

safety filters humanoid robots collision avoidance stress testing robustness evaluation

简要说明：本文在仿真环境中评估并压力测试了人形机器人SPARK多种安全滤波器的鲁棒性，揭示了它们在障碍物密集、传感器噪声等对抗条件下行为表现的差异。

TLDR: The paper evaluates and stress-tests the robustness of various safety filters (RSSA, RSSS, SSA, CBF, PFM, SMA) for a humanoid robot (SPARK) in a simulated environment, identifying behavioral differences under adversarial conditions like obstacle crowding and noisy sensor data.

Abstract: Humanoid robots are difficult to deploy safely because they have high-dimensional bodies, many collision constraints, and must operate near people and obstacles. Safety filters help by modifying a nominal control action when it may violate collision-avoidance constraints. Still, nominal benchmark scores do not fully show how these filters behave in harder environments. In this work, we study the robustness of SPARK humanoid safety filters through replication and stress testing. We replicate the SPARK benchmark case G1SportMode_D1_WG_SO_v1 in MuJoCo and evaluate RSSA, RSSS, SSA, CBF, PFM, and SMA under controlled random seeds. We also built a post-processing pipeline that converts raw SPARK logs into goal-tracking, minimum-distance, and collision-step metrics. Our results show that some methods track the goal more closely, while others reduce collision steps more effectively. The stress tests further indicate that safety behavior can change under obstacle crowding, noisy distance estimates, and delayed obstacle information. These findings suggest that humanoid autonomy should be evaluated beyond nominal performance, using metrics that expose failure modes before deployment.

摘要（中文）：人形机器人因其高维度的身体结构、复杂的碰撞约束条件以及需要在靠近人类与障碍物的环境中作业而难以安全部署。安全过滤器通过在名义控制行为可能违反避障约束时对其进行修正来提升安全性。然而，现有基准测试的性能评分并未完全揭示这些过滤器在更严苛环境中的实际表现。本研究通过复现与压力测试，对SPARK人形机器人安全过滤器的鲁棒性展开分析。我们在MuJoCo中复现了SPARK基准案例G1SportMode_D1_WG_SO_v1，并在受控随机种子条件下评估了RSSA、RSSS、SSA、CBF、PFM和SMA等方法。同时开发了后处理流程，将原始SPARK日志转化为目标追踪精度、最小距离与碰撞步数等量化指标。实验结果表明，部分方法能更精准地追踪目标轨迹，而另一些方法则在减少碰撞步数方面表现更优。压力测试进一步揭示，在障碍物密集、距离估计噪声干扰以及障碍物信息延迟等场景下，安全性能会发生显著变化。这些发现表明，对人形机器人自主性的评估应超越名义性能指标，需采用能暴露潜在故障模式的度量体系，从而在部署前实现更全面的安全验证。

Authors: Saurav Ghosh, Abdou Sow, Luke Zhang

P2DNav: Panorama-to-Downview Reasoning for Zero-shot Vision-and-Language Navigation VLN

vision-and-language navigation zero-shot panorama-to-downview hierarchical framework embodied agent

简要说明：P2DNav 提出了一种用于零样本视觉与语言导航的分层框架，将决策分解为全景方向选择和下视局部落地，在 R2R-CE 基准上实现了强劲性能。

TLDR: P2DNav introduces a hierarchical framework for zero-shot vision-and-language navigation, decomposing decision-making into panoramic direction selection and downview local grounding, achieving strong performance on R2R-CE.

Abstract: Vision-and-language navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to ground natural-language instructions into executable navigation actions in unseen environments. Existing zero-shot methods typically rely on additional waypoint prediction modules, which often entangle high-level directional reasoning with fine-grained local grounding, leading to error-prone and unstable decisions. In this paper, we propose P2DNav, a hierarchical framework for zero-shot vision-and-language navigation. P2DNav consists of three core components: Panorama-to-Downview (P2D), Sliding-Window Dialogue Memory (SDM), and Reflective Reorientation Mechanism (RRM). P2D explicitly decomposes navigation decision-making into two stages: panoramic direction selection and downview local grounding. It first selects the instruction-relevant direction from a 360° panorama, and then predicts a pixel-level target point from the downview RGB observation in that direction. In addition, SDM organizes navigation history as a multi-turn dialogue context and maintains recent visual observations within a sliding window to support long-horizon navigation. RRM further enables reflective reorientation by assessing the reliability of local grounding based on the downview observation and returning to panoramic direction selection when necessary. Experiments on the R2R-CE benchmark show that P2DNav achieves strong performance among zero-shot methods. In particular, compared with the state-of-the-art (SOTA) zero-shot waypoint-based and waypoint-free methods, P2DNav achieves SR gains of 146.6% and 58.9%, respectively, demonstrating the effectiveness of P2D, SDM, and RRM for zero-shot VLN. Code will be released for public use.

摘要（中文）：视觉与语言导航（VLN）要求具身智能体在陌生环境中将自然语言指令转化为可执行的导航动作。现有的零样本方法通常依赖额外的路径点预测模块，这往往将高层方向推理与细粒度局部定位相耦合，导致决策易出错且不稳定。本文提出P2DNav——一种用于零样本视觉与语言导航的层次化框架。该框架包含三个核心组件：全景转俯视图模块、滑动窗口对话记忆模块及反射式重定向机制。全景转俯视图模块将导航决策显式解耦为两个阶段：全景方向选择与俯视图局部定位。该方法首先从360°全景图中选择与指令相关的方向，随后基于该方向的俯视图RGB观测预测像素级目标点。此外，滑动窗口对话记忆模块将导航历史组织为多轮对话上下文，并通过滑动窗口保留近期视觉观测以支持长视野导航。反射式重定向机制进一步实现反射式重定向功能，通过评估基于俯视图观测的局部定位可靠性，并在必要时返回全景方向选择阶段。在R2R-CE基准测试上的实验表明，P2DNav在零样本方法中取得了优异性能。特别是相较于当前最先进的基于路径点的零样本方法和无路径点方法，P2DNav分别实现了146.6%和58.9%的成功率提升，充分证明了全景转俯视图模块、滑动窗口对话记忆模块和反射式重定向机制在零样本视觉与语言导航中的有效性。相关代码将公开以供研究使用。

Authors: Kai Sheng, Liuyi Wang, Haojie Dai, Jinlong Li, Yongrui Qin, Zongtao He, Chengju Liu, Qijun Chen

PhyWorld: Physics-Faithful World Model for Video Generation WorldModel

video generation world model physically faithful continuation flow matching fine-tuning Direct Preference Optimization physical-faithfulness benchmark

简要说明：PhyWorld是一个视频生成世界模型，通过两阶段后训练生成物理忠实度高的视频延续，使其成为更有效的物理AI世界模拟器。

TLDR: PhyWorld is a video generation world model that uses two-stage post-training to produce physically faithful video continuations, making it a more effective world simulator for Physical AI.

Abstract: World simulators can provide safe and scalable environments for training Physical AI systems before real-world deployment. Large video generation models are emerging as a promising basis for such simulators because they can generate diverse and realistic visual futures. However, using them as world simulators requires physically faithful video continuations, namely, generated videos that preserve the physical state implied by the conditioning input, and evolve in ways consistent with basic physical principles. We propose PhyWorld, a video generation world model designed to produce temporally coherent and physically faithful scene continuations through two-stage post-training. In the first stage, we improve video-to-video continuation with flow matching fine-tuning, encouraging stable visual attributes and coherent motion dynamics across frames. In the second stage, we align generated dynamics with physical principles using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) over physics preference pairs, guiding the model toward outputs with higher physical plausibility. To evaluate PhyWorld, we use both standard video-quality benchmarks and a dedicated physical-faithfulness benchmark with per-law scoring. Experiments show that PhyWorld improves video consistency, achieving an average score of 0.769 on VBench compared with 0.756 or below for state-of-the-art baselines. PhyWorld also improves physical plausibility, reaching an average score of 3.09 on our physical-faithfulness benchmark compared with 2.99 for the strongest baseline. These results suggest that post-training large video generation models with continuation and physics-preference signals can make them more effective world simulators for Physical AI.

摘要（中文）：世界模拟器能够为物理人工智能系统在真实世界部署前提供安全且可扩展的训练环境。大型视频生成模型作为此类模拟器的潜在基础正日益受到关注，因为它们能够生成多样化且逼真的视觉未来场景。然而，将其用作世界模拟器需要生成具有物理真实性的视频延续——即生成的视频既能保持条件输入所隐含的物理状态，又能以符合基础物理定律的方式演化。我们提出PhyWorld模型，这是一个通过两阶段后训练设计来生成时间连贯且物理真实场景延续的视频生成世界模型。在第一阶段，我们通过流匹配微调改进视频到视频的延续生成，促进跨帧的稳定视觉属性和连贯运动动态。在第二阶段，我们利用基于物理偏好对的直接偏好优化技术，使生成动态与物理原理对齐，引导模型输出具有更高物理可信度的结果。为评估PhyWorld，我们同时采用标准视频质量基准和专设的物理真实性基准（包含逐定律评分）。实验表明，PhyWorld显著提升了视频一致性，在VBench基准上平均得分达到0.769，优于当前最优基线模型的0.756或更低得分。同时，PhyWorld在物理合理性方面也取得进步，在我们的物理真实性基准上平均得分达3.09，而最强基线模型仅为2.99。这些结果表明，通过延续生成和物理偏好信号对大型视频生成模型进行后训练，能够使其成为更有效的物理人工智能世界模拟器。

简要说明：本文对陆地软体移动机器人的研究现状进行了全面回顾，涵盖了运动、驱动、建模和控制等方面，并指出了其广泛应用所面临的关键研究挑战。

TLDR: This paper provides a comprehensive review of the current state of terrestrial soft mobile robots, covering locomotion, actuation, modeling, and control, and identifies key research challenges for their widespread adoption.

Abstract: Soft mobile robots have emerged as a promising area of research with potential applications in various disciplines including but not limited to search-and-rescue, service, surveillance, explorations, and manufacturing. In this article, we provide a comprehensive review of the current state of soft mobile robot research, focusing on wheelless terrestrial locomotive systems. We include past and present developments in locomotion strategies, actuation methods, modeling approaches, and control systems. Further, we identify key research challenges that must be overcome to enable the widespread adoption of soft mobile robots in various applications. Overall, this article provides a valuable resource for researchers and practitioners interested in the field of soft mobile robots and soft robotics.

摘要（中文）：软体移动机器人已成为一个极具前景的研究领域，其潜在应用涵盖搜索救援、服务、监控、勘探和制造等多个学科。本文系统综述了软体移动机器人的研究现状，聚焦于无轮式陆地运动系统，梳理了运动策略、驱动方法、建模方法及控制系统的历史沿革与最新进展。此外，本文还指出了推动软体移动机器人在各领域广泛应用所必须攻克的关键研究挑战。总体而言，本文为软体移动机器人及软体机器人领域的研究人员和实践者提供了有价值的参考资料。

Authors: Dimuthu D. K. Arachchige

Mechanisms of Misgeneralization in Physical Sequence Modeling WorldModel

generative sequence models physical misgeneralization motion planning data deviation kernel distribution shift

简要说明：本文发现了物理泛化失败现象，即基于筛选物理演示训练的生成序列模型能产生看似合理的单条轨迹，但在物理量（如移动距离）上的总体分布却是错误的，并提供了其机制解释和缓解策略。

TLDR: The paper identifies physical misgeneralization, a failure where generative sequence models trained on curated physical demonstrations produce plausible individual trajectories but wrong aggregate distributions over physical quantities like travel distance, and provides a mechanistic explanation and mitigation strategy.

Abstract: Generative sequence models are often trained to plan motion in physical domains, from robotics to mechanical simulations. When constructing a dataset to train such a model, engineers may curate demonstrations to specify how trajectories should be distributed over a physical quantity like travel distance or mechanical energy. For example, a roboticist building a maze navigation agent might choose demonstrations whose travel distances cover a fixed range uniformly, hoping to constrain the agent's expected power usage. We find that standard deep learning can violate this intent: each generated trajectory can seem plausible on its own, but the aggregate distribution over the physical quantity is wrong. We call this failure physical misgeneralization, and develop an account of its mechanism. Using controlled synthetic tasks, we show that physical misgeneralization arises when local errors typical of the model class propagate through the physical measurement to shift the recovered distribution. We estimate these errors with a data deviation kernel, and we use it to predict which physical quantities gain or lose mass in both our synthetic and more applied maze navigation and double-pendulum motion tasks. Finally, our mechanistic interpretation helps identify which mitigation strategies are structurally promising, and we use it to propose a kernel-informed intervention.

摘要（中文）：生成式序列模型常被训练用于在物理领域中规划运动，涵盖从机器人技术到力学模拟等应用。在构建训练此类模型的数据集时，工程师可能会精心筛选演示数据，以指定轨迹在诸如行进距离或机械能等物理量上的分布方式。例如，构建迷宫导航智能体的机器人专家可能会选择那些行进距离均匀覆盖特定范围的演示数据，以期约束智能体的预期功耗。然而，我们发现标准深度学习方法可能违背这一初衷：虽然每个生成的轨迹单独看似合理，但物理量上的整体分布却出现偏差。我们将这种失效现象称为物理泛化错误，并对其机制展开分析。通过受控的合成任务，我们证明当模型类别典型的局部误差通过物理测量传播时，会改变恢复的分布，从而引发物理泛化错误。我们利用数据偏差核来估计这些误差，并借此预测在合成任务以及更具应用性的迷宫导航与双摆运动任务中，哪些物理量会出现质量增益或损失。最后，我们的机制性解释有助于识别哪些缓解策略在结构上具有潜力，并依此提出了一种基于核信息的干预方法。

PRISM-SLAM: Probabilistic Ray-Grounded Inference for Scale-aware Metric SLAM Perception3D

metric SLAM probabilistic factor graph monocular depth scale ambiguity dynamic scene handling

简要说明：PRISM-SLAM是一种实时单目SLAM框架，通过概率性地集成视觉基础模型的深度先验，实现了面向机器人应用的尺度感知、度量一致定位与建图。

TLDR: PRISM-SLAM is a real-time, monocular SLAM framework that probabilistically integrates vision foundation model depth priors to achieve scale-aware, metric-consistent localization and mapping for robotic applications.

Abstract: Monocular SLAM historically suffers from scale ambiguity and tracking failure in dynamic environments. While recent vision foundation models (VFMs) provide remarkable zero-shot depth priors, naively integrating these deterministic predictions ignores predictive uncertainty and frame-to-frame scale inconsistencies. We propose PRISM-SLAM, a real-time framework that rigorously integrates VFM priors into a structured Bayesian factor graph to achieve scale-aware, metric-consistent localization and mapping. Specifically, we introduce a Plücker Ray-Distance Factor to anchor monocular observations in absolute space within a globally consistent metric coordinate system, mathematically resolving scale drift by making the metric scale Fisher-identifiable. To handle environmental dynamics, we derive an epistemic uncertainty proxy from temporal depth consistency and formulate a Dynamic Scene Uncertainty Gating (DSUG) mechanism. This soft-gating approach probabilistically down-weights dynamic distractors without incurring the heavy computational overhead associated with traditional semantic segmentation masks. By employing a multi-process architecture that asynchronously processes VFM inference and geometric tracking, PRISM-SLAM provides verified metric output at 30 FPS using solely RGB input, bridging the gap between foundation models and real-world robotic applications. Evaluated on the TUM RGB-D and 7-Scenes benchmarks, PRISM-SLAM achieves a metric $SE(3)$ Absolute Trajectory Error (ATE) nearly identical to its oracle-aligned $Sim(3)$ error. This demonstrates that our system can produce deployment-ready metric trajectories by delivering robust metric SLAM solutions without any post-hoc scale correction. Project page: https://prismslam-cmd.github.io/prismslam_pr/

摘要（中文）：摘要：单目SLAM技术长期以来在动态环境中面临尺度不确定性与跟踪失效的问题。虽然当前视觉基础模型（VFMs）提供了卓越的零样本深度先验，但简单地集成这些确定性预测会忽略预测不确定性及帧间尺度不一致性。本文提出PRISM-SLAM框架，通过将VFM先验严格整合至结构化贝叶斯因子图中，实现具备尺度感知与度量一致性的实时定位与建图。具体而言，我们引入普吕克射线距离因子，将单目观测锚定于全局一致度量坐标系下的绝对空间中，通过使度量尺度满足费希尔可识别性，从数学上解决尺度漂移问题。为处理环境动态变化，我们从时序深度一致性中推导认知不确定性代理，并构建动态场景不确定性门控（DSUG）机制。这种软门控方法能够概率性地降低动态干扰因素的影响，而无需传统语义分割掩码带来的沉重计算开销。通过采用异步处理VFM推理与几何跟踪的多进程架构，PRISM-SLAM仅使用RGB输入即可实现30帧/秒的已验证度量输出，弥合了基础模型与实际机器人应用之间的鸿沟。在TUM RGB-D和7-Scenes基准测试中，PRISM-SLAM的度量$SE(3)$绝对轨迹误差（ATE）与其经过对齐处理的$Sim(3)$误差几乎一致。这表明该系统无需任何后验尺度校正，即可通过提供鲁棒的度量SLAM解决方案生成可直接部署的度量轨迹。项目页面：https://prismslam-cmd.github.io/prismslam_pr/

Authors: Eunsoo Im

SceneCode: Executable World Programs for Editable Indoor Scenes with Articulated Objects WorldModel

programmatic world generation executable indoor scene articulated objects physics simulation robot interaction

简要说明：SceneCode是一个将自然语言提示编译为可执行的代码驱动室内世界、用于物理模拟和机器人交互的框架，提升了符合提示的室内场景生成和物体关节结构质量。

TLDR: SceneCode is a framework that compiles natural language prompts into executable code-driven indoor worlds for physics simulation and robot interaction, improving prompt-faithful scene generation and asset articulation.

Abstract: Indoor scene synthesis underpins embodied AI, robotic manipulation, and simulation-based policy evaluation, where a useful scene must specify not only what the environment looks like, but also how its objects are structured. Existing pipelines, however, typically represent generated content as static meshes and inherit articulation only from curated asset libraries, which limits object-level controllability and prevents new interactable assets from being produced on demand. We address this gap by formulating physically interactable indoor scene synthesis as programmatic world generation, and present SceneCode, a framework that compiles a natural language prompt into an executable, code-driven indoor world rather than a collection of opaque meshes. A room-level agentic backbone first turns the prompt into a structured house layout and emits per-object AssetRequests through a planner--designer--critic loop. Each request is then routed to one of five code-generation strategies and converted into a synthesized part-wise Blender Python programs that are validated through an execution-guided repair-and-refine loop. The resulting programs are compiled into simulation-ready assets, and exported as SDF for physics simulation. A persistent scene-state registry links object requests, executable programs, rendered geometry, and simulation assets, turning scene assembly into a traceable and locally editable world-building process. We evaluate SceneCode across scene-level synthesis, object-level asset quality, human judgment, and downstream robot interaction. Results show that executable world programs improve prompt-faithful indoor scene generation and produce assets with cleaner mesh structure, and simulator-loadable articulation metadata. Project page: https://scene-code.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：室内场景合成是具身人工智能、机器人操作及基于仿真的策略评估的基础，其中有效的场景不仅需明确环境外观，还需阐明其物体的结构方式。然而，现有流程通常将生成内容表示为静态网格，仅从精选资产库中继承关节结构，这限制了对象层面的可控性，并阻碍了按需生成新的可交互资产。为填补这一空白，我们将物理可交互的室内场景合成定义为程序化世界生成，并提出SceneCode框架，该框架将自然语言提示编译为可执行的代码驱动室内世界，而非一组不透明的网格集合。一个房间级智能主干首先将提示转换为结构化房屋布局，并通过规划器-设计者-评判者循环为每个对象生成资产请求。随后，每个请求被路由至五种代码生成策略之一，并转换为合成的分部件Blender Python程序，这些程序通过执行引导的修复与优化循环进行验证。最终生成的程序被编译为可直接用于仿真的资产，并导出为SDF格式以支持物理仿真。一个持久的场景状态注册表将对象请求、可执行程序、渲染几何体及仿真资产关联起来，使场景组装转变为可追踪且支持局部编辑的世界构建过程。我们在场景级合成、对象级资产质量、人工判断及下游机器人交互任务中对SceneCode进行了全面评估。结果表明，可执行的世界程序提升了提示忠实度，生成出网格结构更清晰、具备仿真器可加载的关节元数据的室内场景资产。项目页面：https://scene-code.github.io/。
